description.en: LoadingController on LoadingScene: preloads carousel sprites in one pass, starts loading the target scene, normalises the 0.9 progress into the bar, and activates the scene only after progress is full, carousel assets are ready and at least one frame has rendered. Everything uses unscaled time so a frozen timeScale cannot deadlock it.

description.zh: 读 LoadingTableConfig 过滤 enable 并按 sort 排序后，一次性 Resources.LoadAsync 全部轮播图；每张按自己的 showSeconds/fadeSeconds 停留与淡出，失败或缺失的图也计入进度分母（否则 assetsReady 永远达不到 1，进度条会卡死在 100% 之前）。
description.en: Reads LoadingTableConfig, filters on enable and sorts by sort, then loads every carousel sprite in one Resources.LoadAsync pass. Each entry holds and fades for its own showSeconds/fadeSeconds. Missing or failed sprites still count toward the progress denominator — otherwise assetsReady never reaches 1 and the bar deadlocks just short of 100%.

description.en: TryFail switches the screen to a dark-red background with a red bar and records LastRunFailed, so the player sees a failure instead of a frozen black screen. IsSceneInBuildSettings is only a soft pre-check — Application.CanStreamedLevelBeLoaded is deliberately avoided because on this Unity version it returns false even for registered scenes in the editor.

description.zh: TryFail：失败态上色与标记，不黑屏卡死。
description.en: TryFail: colours and flags failure without freezing.

description.zh: IsSceneInBuildSettings：按约定路径软预检构建清单。
description.en: IsSceneInBuildSettings: soft check against build list.

description.zh: 兜底色/失败色常量。
description.en: Fallback and failure colour constants.

description.zh: Run 协程：把后台加载线程优先级提到 High，用 unscaled 时间推进轮播与进度，做 0.9 封顶归一化（激活后 progress 会跳到 1.0，故用 Clamp01 双保险），等进度满+资源就绪+至少一帧后置 allowSceneActivation=true；退出时恢复原优先级。
description.en: The Run coroutine: raises the background loading thread priority to High, advances carousel and progress on unscaled time, normalises the 0.9 ceiling (progress jumps to 1.0 after activation, hence the Clamp01 belt-and-braces), and sets allowSceneActivation=true only once progress is full, assets are ready and a frame has rendered; restores the original priority on exit.

description.zh: Run 协程：加载、归一化、激活的完整时序。
description.en: Run coroutine: full load/normalise/activate sequence.

description.zh: RestorePriority：归还后台加载线程优先级。
description.en: RestorePriority: restores loading thread priority.

label.zh: 持控式异步加载目标场景

description.zh: 供自动化验收读取的 static 运行统计：进度满时刻、目标场景激活时刻、激活前最大单帧、加载帧数、目标场景名、是否失败。设计成 static 是因为 LoadingScene 激活瞬间本对象会被销毁。sceneLoaded 静态回调只注册一次并把激活时刻写回。
description.en: Static run statistics for automated acceptance: time progress hit full, time the target scene activated, largest pre-activation frame delta, loading frame count, target scene name and failure flag. They are static because this object is destroyed the moment LoadingScene activates. A static sceneLoaded callback is hooked exactly once and writes the activation timestamp back.

description.zh: 进度首次到满的时刻（realtime）。
description.en: Realtime moment progress first hit full.

description.zh: 目标场景完成激活的时刻（realtime）。
description.en: Realtime moment the target scene activated.

description.zh: 激活前（跳过第 1 帧）的最大单帧时长。
description.en: Largest pre-activation frame delta seconds.

description.zh: 最近一次加载的目标场景名。
description.en: Target scene name of the latest load.

description.zh: 最近一次加载是否失败（停在读条界面）。
description.en: Whether the latest load failed and stalled.

description.zh: HookSceneLoadedOnce/OnAnySceneLoaded：一次性注册并记录激活时刻。
description.en: HookSceneLoadedOnce/OnAnySceneLoaded: one-shot hook.

description.zh: 按硬约定节点名（BgImage / FadeImage / ProgressBar/Fill）在 Canvas 下找控件，并把进度条强制设成 Filled/Horizontal/Left；每帧把 0~1 的进度写进 fillAmount。找不到节点只报错不崩，读条界面退化成纯色底。
description.en: Locates widgets by hard-coded node names (BgImage / FadeImage / ProgressBar/Fill) under the Canvas and forces the bar to Filled/Horizontal/Left; writes 0..1 progress into fillAmount each frame. Missing nodes log an error rather than crash, degrading to a flat coloured screen.

description.zh: Awake/Start/FindNodes：定位背景、遮罩与进度条节点。
description.en: Awake/Start/FindNodes: locates background, fade and bar.

description.zh: SetProgressVisual：把归一化进度写进进度条。
description.en: SetProgressVisual: writes progress into the bar.

description.zh: 替不继承 MonoBehaviour 的普通 C# 类接管 Unity 生命周期与协程：MonoController 是真正挂在 GameObject 上的 MonoBehaviour，MonoManager 是它对外的单例门面。
description.en: Gives plain C# classes (which cannot extend MonoBehaviour) access to Unity lifecycle and coroutines: MonoController is the real MonoBehaviour on a GameObject, MonoManager is the singleton facade in front of it.

description.zh: 真正挂在 GameObject 上的 MonoBehaviour：每帧 Update 里扇出 updateEvent，并把宿主对象标记为 DontDestroyOnLoad，让订阅者跨场景存活。
description.en: The actual MonoBehaviour on a GameObject: fans out updateEvent every Update and marks its host DontDestroyOnLoad so subscribers survive scene switches.

description.zh: 注册每帧回调。
description.en: Registers a per-frame callback.

description.zh: 注销每帧回调。
description.en: Unregisters a per-frame callback.

description.zh: 清空全部每帧回调。
description.en: Clears all per-frame callbacks.

description.zh: 每帧扇出的事件（UnityAction）。
description.en: Per-frame fan-out event (UnityAction).

description.zh: 心跳控制器全文。
description.en: Whole tick controller source.

description.zh: MonoController 的单例门面（继承 SingletonBase）。构造函数创建一个名为 MonoController 的 GameObject 并挂上控制器，保证唯一性；对外转发帧更新注册与 StartCoroutine。
description.en: Singleton facade over MonoController (extends SingletonBase). Its constructor creates the uniquely named "MonoController" GameObject and attaches the controller; it forwards update registration and StartCoroutine to the outside world.

description.zh: 构造函数：创建唯一 MonoController 宿主对象。
description.en: Constructor: creates the unique MonoController host object.

description.zh: 转发注册每帧回调。
description.en: Forwards per-frame callback registration.

description.zh: 转发注销每帧回调。
description.en: Forwards per-frame callback removal.

description.zh: 让非 MonoBehaviour 类也能起协程（三个重载）。
description.en: Lets non-MonoBehaviour classes run coroutines (three overloads).

description.zh: 心跳管理器全文。
description.en: Whole tick manager source.

description.zh: 全工程唯一一处调用 SceneManager 的地方：同步加载、协程异步加载、以及把 AsyncOperation 交给调用方自己持控进度与激活时机的加载方式。
description.en: The single place in the project that calls SceneManager: synchronous load, coroutine async load, and a hand-off async load that returns the AsyncOperation so the caller controls progress and activation timing.

description.zh: ScenesLoadManager：LoadScene 同步切换并回调、LoadSceneAsync 用 MonoManager 协程一口气加载并激活、BeginLoadSceneAsync 返回 AsyncOperation 且默认 allowSceneActivation=false（进度最高 0.9，需 Clamp01）。场景名为空或不在 Build Settings 时返回 null 并报错，不抛异常。
description.en: ScenesLoadManager: LoadScene switches synchronously and invokes the callback; LoadSceneAsync runs through a MonoManager coroutine; BeginLoadSceneAsync returns the AsyncOperation with allowSceneActivation defaulting to false (progress tops out at 0.9, so callers must Clamp01). A null or unregistered scene returns null with an error instead of throwing.

description.zh: 同步加载场景，随后无条件回调（传 null 会 NRE）。
description.en: Loads a scene synchronously, then invokes (null throws NRE).

description.zh: 协程异步加载并自动激活。
description.en: Loads asynchronously via coroutine and auto-activates.

description.zh: 返回 AsyncOperation，调用方自己持控进度与激活时机。
description.en: Returns AsyncOperation; caller controls progress/activation.

description.zh: 加载管理器全文。
description.en: Whole load manager source.

description.zh: Assets/Scenes 下的 4 个场景：TestScene 是构建清单第 0 项并挂 Entry，WorldScene 是游戏世界，LoadingScene 挂 LoadingController 读条，EnterScene 是备用进入场景（当前未登记进构建清单）。
description.en: The four scenes under Assets/Scenes: TestScene is build-list entry 0 and hosts Entry, WorldScene is the game world, LoadingScene hosts LoadingController, and EnterScene is a spare entry scene that is currently not registered in the build list.

description.zh: EnterScene.unity：早期版本的进入场景，当前没有任何本工程脚本挂载，也未被 EditorBuildSettings 登记（构建清单只含 TestScene/WorldScene/LoadingScene）。属于保留资产。
description.en: EnterScene.unity: an early entry scene. No project script is attached to it and it is not registered in EditorBuildSettings (the build list only holds TestScene, WorldScene and LoadingScene). Kept as a spare asset.

description.zh: 进入场景资产（未登记进构建清单）。
description.en: Enter scene asset (not in the build list).

description.zh: LoadingScene.unity：独立小场景，构建清单第 2 项。Canvas 下挂着 LoadingController（组件挂在场景里，不是 prefab），刻意不叫 Canvas、不挂 Entry、不做 DontDestroyOnLoad，每次加载都是干净的新对象。
description.en: LoadingScene.unity: a standalone mini scene, build-list entry 2. LoadingController is attached under its Canvas (a scene component, not a prefab). It deliberately avoids being named Canvas, hosting Entry or using DontDestroyOnLoad, so every load starts from clean objects.

description.zh: 读条场景资产（Canvas 挂 LoadingController）。
description.en: Loading scene asset (Canvas hosts the controller).

description.zh: TestScene.unity：构建清单第 0 项（启动场景），场景里挂 Entry 触发 UI/输入/设置的初始化。也是本工程唯一实际跑得起来的入口场景。
description.en: TestScene.unity: build-list entry 0 (the startup scene). It hosts Entry, which triggers UI, input and settings initialisation. It is also the only entry scene that actually runs in this project.

description.zh: 启动测试场景资产（挂 Entry）。
description.en: Test scene asset (hosts Entry).

description.zh: WorldScene.unity：构建清单第 1 项，游戏世界场景，也是 SLPanel 读档成功后切进去的目标场景。当前没有任何本任务范围内的脚本挂载。
description.en: WorldScene.unity: build-list entry 1, the game world scene and the target SLPanel switches to after loading a save. No script from this task's scope is attached to it.

description.zh: 世界场景资产。
description.en: World scene asset.

description.zh: 三种单例形态：普通 C# 类单例（懒 new）、需手动挂载的 MonoBehaviour 单例、以及自动创建 GameObject 并跨场景保留的 MonoBehaviour 单例。
description.en: Three singleton flavours: a plain C# lazy-new singleton, a MonoBehaviour singleton that must be attached manually, and a MonoBehaviour singleton that auto-creates its GameObject and survives scene loads.

description.zh: 继承 MonoBehaviour 的单例基类，但首次 GetInstance() 时自动 new GameObject + AddComponent<T> 并 DontDestroyOnLoad，调用方不需要手动摆放。
description.en: MonoBehaviour singleton base that auto-creates a GameObject, adds T and marks it DontDestroyOnLoad on the first GetInstance() call — callers never place it manually.

description.zh: 取实例；不存在时自动创建并跨场景保留。
description.en: Returns the instance, auto-creating it across scenes.

description.zh: 自动 Mono 单例基类全文。
description.en: Whole auto Mono singleton base source.

description.zh: 不继承 MonoBehaviour 的单例基类：Instance 首次访问时 new T()，之后复用同一实例。MonoManager、ScenesLoadManager 都走这一套。
description.en: Singleton base for classes that do not extend MonoBehaviour: Instance lazily news up T on first access and reuses it afterwards. MonoManager and ScenesLoadManager both use it.

description.zh: 懒加载的全局唯一实例。
description.en: Lazily created global instance.

description.zh: 普通单例基类全文。
description.en: Whole plain singleton base source.

description.zh: 继承 MonoBehaviour 的单例基类：实例由 Unity 在 Awake 里写回静态字段，外部用 GetInstance() 取；不自动创建对象，需要手动挂到场景里。
description.en: Singleton base for MonoBehaviours: Unity writes the instance into a static field during Awake and callers use GetInstance(). It never auto-creates a GameObject — the component must be placed in the scene manually.

description.zh: 取当前已挂载的实例（未挂载时为 null）。
description.en: Returns the attached instance (null when unattached).

description.zh: Awake 里把 this 写回静态实例字段。
description.en: Writes this into the static instance field in Awake.

description.zh: Mono 单例基类全文。
description.en: Whole Mono singleton base source.

description.zh: Excel 配置表全链路：Assets/Excel 下的表仓 xlsx 与本地化 CSV、ConfigManager/ConfigLoader/FileUtil 的导出与运行时读取、7 行表头约定与 12 类型白名单、生成物 Resources/Data/Json/Runtime/*.json 与 MVP/Model/ConfigData/*.cs、SL/Recorder 的本地记录数据。
description.en: End-to-end Excel config pipeline: the xlsx table repo and localization CSVs under Assets/Excel, export and runtime reading via ConfigManager/ConfigLoader/FileUtil, the 7-row header convention and 12-type whitelist, generated Resources/Data/Json/Runtime/*.json and MVP/Model/ConfigData/*.cs, plus SL/Recorder local record data.

description.zh: ConfigManager 里的 Excel 导出器：读取表目录下所有 .xlsx，为 Config（只读常量）与 Data（可写存档）两种模式生成 Json 与 C# 数据类，并通过 FileUtil 写盘。所有入口都是 ExcelTool 下的编辑器菜单。
description.en: The Excel exporter inside ConfigManager: reads every .xlsx in the table folder, generates JSON plus C# data classes for both Config (read-only constants) and Data (writable saves) modes, and writes them through FileUtil. All entry points are editor-only menus under ExcelTool.

description.zh: 生成 C# 容器类：前缀 using System 与 [Serializable]，类名 = 表名 + 模式名，然后逐列输出 public 字段——字段类型原样照抄第 6 行文本，行尾注释取第 3 行。第 5 行标 server 的列整列丢弃。
description.en: Generates the C# container class: prepends using System and [Serializable], names the class file-name plus mode, then emits one public field per column, copying row 6 text verbatim as the field type and row 3 as the trailing comment. Columns marked server in row 5 are dropped entirely.

description.zh: ExportClass（C# 数据类生成器）所在行段。
description.en: Line range of ExportClass, the C# data-class code generator.

description.zh: 按表生成 Config/Data 模式的可序列化类。
description.en: Emits a serializable class per table for Config or Data mode.

description.zh: ExcelTool 菜单下的编辑器入口：ExportExcel 同时跑两种模式，ExportExcelConfigs/ExportExcelModels 各跑一种。每次遍历表目录下所有文件、过滤非 .xlsx、读第 1 个页签，遇到空维度表就 return（会中断整批导出），然后逐表导出 Json 与类，最后 AssetDatabase.Refresh。
description.en: Editor entry points under the ExcelTool menu: ExportExcel runs both modes, ExportExcelConfigs and ExportExcelModels run one each. Each pass loads every file in the table folder, skips non-.xlsx, reads worksheet 1, returns early on an empty-dimension sheet (which aborts the whole batch), then exports JSON and a class per table before refreshing the asset database.

description.zh: 导出菜单与两模式编排所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding the export menus and their two-mode orchestration.

description.zh: 同时跑 Config 与 Data 导出的菜单项。
description.en: Menu item running both Config and Data export.

description.zh: 只导出常量 Config 表的菜单项。
description.en: Menu item exporting only the constant Config tables.

description.zh: 只导出可写 Data 表的菜单项。
description.en: Menu item exporting only the writable Data tables.

description.zh: 遍历 xlsx 并以 Config 模式导出 Json 与类。
description.en: Iterates xlsx files and exports JSON plus classes in Config mode.

description.zh: 遍历 xlsx 并以 Data 模式导出 Json 与类。
description.en: Iterates xlsx files and exports JSON plus classes in Data mode.

description.zh: 导出器与 Recorder 共用的文件系统助手：把路径拼到 Application.dataPath 下，枚举目录内容并跳过 .meta 与 ~ 临时文件，保存时先删后写。它不会创建目录——输出目录不存在会直接报错，而不是静默什么都不做。
description.en: Filesystem helper shared by the exporter and Recorder: resolves paths against Application.dataPath, lists folder contents while skipping .meta and ~temp files, and saves by deleting then writing. It never creates directories, so a missing output folder is a hard error rather than a silent no-op.

description.zh: 共用的目录枚举与写文件助手。
description.en: The shared file listing and saving helper.

description.zh: 列出 Assets 下某目录的非 meta 文件，目录不存在就报错。
description.en: Lists non-meta files in a folder under Assets, throwing if absent.

description.zh: 覆盖式写文件（无备份），目录不存在就报错。
description.en: Overwrites a file without backup, throwing if the folder is absent.

description.zh: Json 文本拼装，带一个关键脆弱点：重组行时是把整段紧凑文本按逗号 Split 再重排，因此某个 string 单元格里出现英文逗号会静默写坏整表 Json（日志却显示成功）；字符串内的双引号与换行同样不做转义。
description.en: JSON text assembly with an important fragility: rows are regrouped by splitting the whole compact text on commas, so a string cell containing a comma silently corrupts the whole table's JSON while the log still reports success. Quotes and newlines inside strings are not escaped either.

description.zh: Json 文本拼装函数所在行段。
description.en: Line range of the JSON text assemblers.

description.zh: 拼一条 key:value 片段。
description.en: Formats one key:value pair.

description.zh: 把扁平键值重组为 datas 数组。
description.en: Reshapes flat pairs into a datas array.

description.zh: 包成 JsonUtility.FromJson 可读的外壳。
description.en: Wraps the array for JsonUtility.FromJson.

description.zh: 排版阶段，把导出的 .json 与 .record 变成人读格式，风格与 JsonUtility.ToJson(obj, true) 一致（4 空格缩进）。实现会跟踪字符串状态与转义，避免把中文文本里的逗号、冒号、花括号误当结构符；空白对 JsonUtility 无影响。
description.en: Formatting pass that makes exported .json and .record files human-readable at the same 4-space style as JsonUtility.ToJson(obj, true). It tracks string state and escapes so commas, colons and braces inside Chinese text are not mistaken for structure; whitespace is not significant to JsonUtility.

description.zh: Json 美化器所在行段。
description.en: Line range of the JSON pretty-printer.

description.zh: 把紧凑 Json 美化为 4 空格缩进。
description.en: Pretty-prints compact JSON with 4-space indentation.

description.zh: 逐表 Json 写出：遍历列，跳过端标记为 server 与留空的列，逐格经类型白名单转换，拼成键值对，再把扁平文本重组为 datas 数组，包一层 JsonUtility 可读的外壳，美化后按模式存为 .json（Config）或 .record（Data）。转换失败会带上表/页签/行列/字段/类型上下文重新抛出。
description.en: Per-table JSON writer: walks the columns, skips server-marked and blank-marked ones, converts each cell through the type whitelist, joins key-value pairs, reshapes the flat text into a datas array, wraps it for JsonUtility, pretty-prints it, and saves as .json (Config) or .record (Data). Conversion failures are rethrown with sheet, row, column, field and type context.

description.zh: ExportJson（逐表记录写出）所在行段。
description.en: Line range of ExportJson, the per-table record writer.

description.zh: 为单表构建并写出 datas 数组。
description.en: Builds and writes the datas array for one table.

description.zh: 硬编码的 7 行表头约定：第 1 行类名（仅供人看）、第 2 行是否读取（未实现）、第 3 行中文备注、第 4 行英文属性名（唯一强校验，为空直接抛异常）、第 5 行端标记（server 从类与 Json 整列丢弃；留空只从 Json 丢弃）、第 6 行类型、第 7 行起为数据。第 7 行就是第一条数据；表尾留空行会变成一条空记录。
description.en: The hard-coded 7-row header contract: row 1 class name (human only), row 2 read flag (not implemented), row 3 Chinese remark, row 4 English property name (the only hard validation - blank throws), row 5 end marker (server drops the column from class and JSON, blank drops it from JSON only), row 6 type, row 7 onward data. Row 7 is the first data row; a trailing blank row becomes an empty record.

description.zh: 硬编码表头行号常量所在行段。
description.en: Line range of the hard-coded header row index constants.

description.zh: 表头与单元格读取函数所在行段。
description.en: Line range of the header and cell range readers.

description.zh: 读第 4 行字段名，为空则报错。
description.en: Reads row 4 field names, throwing on a blank one.

description.zh: 读第 5 行端标记（client/both/server）。
description.en: Reads row 5 end markers (client/both/server).

description.zh: 从第 7 行往下读一列单元格文本。
description.en: Reads a column's cell text from row 7 down.

description.zh: 读第 3 行中文备注做字段注释。
description.en: Reads row 3 Chinese remarks for field comments.

description.zh: ExcelTool/ExportExcelConfigs 生成的运行期常量 Json，位于 Resources/Data/Json/Runtime，固定结构为 {"datas":[...]}，由 ConfigLoader 用 JsonUtility 反序列化为 DataList<T>。属派生产物，表改了要重跑导出。
description.en: Runtime constant JSON produced by ExcelTool/ExportExcelConfigs under Resources/Data/Json/Runtime. Every file has the fixed shape {"datas":[...]}, which ConfigLoader deserialises into DataList<T> with JsonUtility. Derived artifacts: re-run the export after editing a table.

description.zh: LoadingTable 的导出常量表：3 条轮播条目，含图片路径、播放顺序、停留与淡入淡出秒数以及启用开关。导出后的 bool 是裸小写 true —— 这是 JsonUtility 能接受的形式。
description.en: Exported constant table for LoadingTable: three carousel entries with image path, sort order, dwell and fade seconds, and an enable flag. Note the exported bool is a bare lowercase true, which is what JsonUtility requires.

description.zh: 导出的 LoadingTable 常量 Json，含 3 条轮播数据。
description.en: Exported LoadingTable constant JSON with 3 carousel rows.

description.zh: TestTable 的导出常量表：4 条 Index / CharName / Occupation / head_icon 数据。运行时由 ConfigLoader.LoadData<TestTableConfig> 读取的产物。
description.en: Exported constant table for TestTable: four rows of Index, CharName, Occupation and head_icon. This is the artifact ConfigLoader.LoadData<TestTableConfig> reads at runtime.

description.zh: 导出的 TestTable 常量 Json，含 4 条数据。
description.en: Exported TestTable constant JSON with 4 data rows.

description.zh: 导出器生成的 C# 数据类：Config 模式写 MVP/Model/ConfigData（只读常量），Data 模式写 MVP/Model/ModelData（可写存档）。类名 = 表名第一个 _ 前的英文段 + Config/Data；字段名取第 4 行，类型取第 6 行原样，行尾注释取第 3 行。
description.en: Generated C# data classes. Config mode writes MVP/Model/ConfigData (read-only constants); Data mode writes MVP/Model/ModelData (writable, used for saves). Class name = the table file name up to the first underscore plus Config or Data; field names come from row 4, types from row 6 verbatim, trailing comments from row 3.

description.zh: 轮播读条表的 Config 模式生成类：Id(uint)、srcImg(string)、sort(uint)、showSeconds(float)、fadeSeconds(float)、enable(bool)。注意第 5 行端标记留空时，该列会从 Json 中丢弃但 C# 字段保留（永远是默认值）。
description.en: Generated Config-mode class for the loading carousel: Id (uint), srcImg (string), sort (uint), showSeconds (float), fadeSeconds (float) and enable (bool). Note that a blank row-5 end marker drops the column from JSON but keeps the C# field at its default value.

description.zh: LoadingTable 的常量字段容器（生成）。
description.en: Generated LoadingTable field container for constants.

description.zh: 可序列化的 LoadingTable 配置行类。

description.en: Window presentation layer: status message with error styling, repo info block, warning block (Unity running, detached head, in-progress operation), action buttons, categorized preview list capped at 300 files, and an open-terminal helper.

description.zh: 窗口绘制与终端辅助所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding the window drawing and terminal helper.

description.zh: 打开 Git 拉取助手窗口的菜单项。
description.en: Menu item opening the Git pull assistant window.

description.zh: 打开 Git 拉取助手窗口。
description.en: Opens the Git pull assistant window.

description.zh: 绘制操作按钮区。
description.en: Draws the action buttons section.

description.zh: 绘制分类后的更新预览列表。
description.en: Draws the categorized update preview list.

description.zh: 按键图标映射工具：扫描 Assets/Art/icon 图标库，按文件名解析控制键/风格/变体，自动匹配写入 KeyIconMap，给预制体按键行补图标显示位（KeyIconText + Icon 子节点），并按设备页签应用图标。库中无法识别的图会如实列出，而不是硬塞给某个控制。
description.en: Key icon mapping: scans the Art/icon library, parses control key, style and variant from file names, auto-matches them into KeyIconMap, adds icon slots to prefab key rows (KeyIconText plus Icon child), and applies per-device tab icons. Unrecognised glyphs are listed as-is instead of being forced onto a wrong control.

description.zh: 图标命名规则：把设备族目录与文件名解析为设备族、token、风格与变体，通过带优先级的对照表把 token 解析成控制键，标记纯字形与未知 token，扫描全库，按风格偏好与变体惩罚选最优，并输出人读描述。
description.en: Icon naming rules: parses family folders and file names into device family, token, style and variant, resolves token to control keys through a ranked table, marks glyph-only and unknown tokens, scans the whole library, picks the best match honouring style preference and variant penalty, and describes the result.

description.zh: 图标名解析、扫描与最优选择逻辑所在文件。
description.en: The icon name parser, scanner and best-pick logic.

description.zh: 从文件名解析设备族、token、风格与变体。
description.en: Parses device family, token, style and variant from a file name.

description.zh: 扫描图标库得到 IconInfo 列表。
description.en: Scans the icon library into IconInfo records.

description.zh: 为控制键与设备族选最优图标。
description.en: Picks the best icon for a control key and device family.

description.zh: 报告解析结果与未识别文件。
description.en: Reports parsing results and unrecognised files.

description.zh: 把设备族映射到页签图标文件名。
description.en: Maps a device family to its tab icon file name.

description.zh: 按键图标的预制体侧：遍历面板预制体，在每个按键行下补建或修复 KeyIconText + Icon 子节点，应用自动尺寸，解析设备页签图标文件名，并提供窗口与 ForTest 钩子使用的批量补位/页签入口。
description.en: Prefab side of key icons: walks panel prefabs, adds or repairs the KeyIconText plus Icon child under each key row, applies auto-size, resolves device tab icon file names, and drives batch patch/tab-icon entry points used by the window and by ForTest hooks.

description.zh: 预制体按键行补位与页签图标所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding prefab key-row patching and tab icons.

description.zh: 给所有预制体的按键行补图标显示位。
description.en: Adds icon slots to every prefab key row.

description.zh: 确保单个按键行有键名文本与图标位。
description.en: Ensures one key row has a key text plus icon slot.

description.zh: 把映射表套到设备页签按钮上。
description.en: Applies the map to device tab buttons.

description.zh: 在默认路径新建一份 KeyIconMap 资产。
description.en: Creates a fresh KeyIconMap asset at the default path.

description.zh: 按键图标映射窗口：带映射资产槽与 tint 的头部、选项（优先字形/优先手写风格）、扫描与自动匹配/按页签应用图标动作、覆盖率读数、可筛选的映射表（标记是否被输入资产引用），以及未识别图标清单。同时持有 Resources 下的默认映射表路径常量。
description.en: Key icon map window: header with the map asset slot and tint, options (prefer glyph, prefer handwritten style), scan/auto-match/tab-icon actions, coverage readout, filterable table of entries with used-in-asset markers, and a list of unrecognised icons. Also owns the default map path under Resources.

description.zh: 映射表窗口 UI、筛选与自动匹配所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding the map window UI, filters and auto-match.

description.zh: 打开按键图标映射窗口的菜单项。
description.en: Menu item opening the key icon map window.

description.zh: 打开按键图标映射窗口。
description.en: Opens the key icon mapping window.

description.zh: 按控制键把图标库匹配进映射表。
description.en: Matches library icons into the map by control key.

description.zh: 收集输入资产里用到的控制键。
description.en: Collects control keys referenced by input assets.

description.zh: 本地化编辑工具链：面板 TMP 文字收集器（扫描→勾选→导入子配置→回写 LocalizedText）、条目编辑窗口（增删改 + CSV 导入导出）、子配置合并器（Sub_LD → ChaosLocalizationConfig 运行期整表）、语言字体映射窗口（TMP 字体覆盖率探测与预制体批量换字）。
description.en: Localization editing chain: prefab TMP text collector (scan, select, import into sub-configs, write back LocalizedText), entry editor (CRUD + CSV import/export), sub-config merger (Sub_LD into the runtime ChaosLocalizationConfig table), and the language font map window (TMP coverage probing + batch font patching).

description.zh: 把勾选条目的 Key/中文写入目标本地化配置资产（已存在则更新），刷新已存在/Key 冲突标记，并在重扫后按条目 ID 恢复选中；含一批 ForTest 钩子用于脚本驱动端到端验证。
description.en: Writes selected entries' keys and Chinese text into the target localization config asset (updating existing rows), refreshes the exists/collision flags, and restores selection by item id after rescanning; includes ForTest hooks for scripted end-to-end verification.

description.zh: 导入配置、状态刷新与选中恢复所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding config import, status refresh and selection restore.

description.zh: 把当前勾选条目导入目标本地化配置。
description.en: Imports the currently selected entries into the target config.

description.zh: 导入实现：逐条写入或更新配置条目。
description.en: Import implementation that writes or updates each entry.

description.zh: 刷新「已存在于配置」与 Key 冲突标记。
description.en: Refreshes the already-in-config and duplicate-key flags.

description.zh: 脚本驱动端到端管线（扫描→导入→回写）的测试钩子。
description.en: Test hook running the whole scan-import-writeback pipeline.

name.zh: 文字扫描与 Key 生成

description.zh: 扫描管线：按目录/单个 prefab/场景三类输入收集 TMP 文字，重建对象层级路径，按面板名与路径生成唯一 Key（含设置面板的 Setting 前缀特例），并记录首尾空白与 Key 冲突。
description.en: Scan pipeline: collects TMP text from directories, single prefabs and scenes, rebuilds object hierarchy paths, derives unique keys from prefab name and path (with the setting-panel prefix special case), and flags leading/trailing whitespace and key collisions.

description.zh: 扫描与 Key 生成实现所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding the scan and key-generation implementation.

description.zh: 按搜索路径批量扫描并分组收集文字。
description.en: Scans all search paths and groups collected text.

description.zh: 扫描单个预制体，提取其 TMP 文字。
description.en: Scans one prefab and extracts its TMP texts.

description.zh: 扫描场景（Additive 打开后关闭）中的硬编码文字。
description.en: Scans a scene for hard-coded texts, opening it additively.

description.zh: 由面板名与对象路径推导本地化 Key。
description.en: Derives a localization key from prefab name and object path.

description.zh: 收集器窗口外壳与数据模型：搜索路径区、目标配置区、结果列表与条目行、勾选/清除动作栏，TextItem 记录文字来源（预制体/场景）、层级路径、原文本与已存在标记。静默模式下只写日志不弹模态框。
description.en: Collector window shell and data model: search-path section, target-config section, result list and item rows, selection/clear action bar; TextItem records the text source (prefab/scene), hierarchy path, raw text and already-exists flags. Silent mode logs instead of showing modal dialogs.

description.zh: 收集器窗口 UI 与 TextItem 数据模型所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding the collector window UI and TextItem data model.

apis.path: Menu/Tools/本地化/面板文字收集器

description.en: Editor menu item that opens the prefab text collector window.

apis.key: rpc:Menu/Tools/本地化/面板文字收集器

description.zh: 打开收集器窗口并设定最小尺寸。

description.en: Silent switch: skips modal confirmations when true.

description.zh: 一条「预制体/场景里的文字」记录。
description.en: One collected text record from a prefab or scene.

description.zh: 把 Key 回写到预制体/场景对象：给目标补 LocalizedText 组件并设 Key，清理选中条目的本地化组件；预制体走 LoadPrefabContents 隔离编辑，场景走已加载场景并按 dirty 收集保存。
description.en: Writes keys back to prefab/scene objects: adds LocalizedText components and assigns keys, or clears localization on selected items; prefabs are edited through LoadPrefabContents and scenes through loaded-scene lookup with dirty tracking.

description.zh: 预制体/场景组件回写与清理所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding prefab/scene component write-back and cleanup.

description.zh: 按来源分派预制体与场景的组件回写。
description.en: Dispatches component write-back per source kind.

description.zh: 在隔离场景中给预制体对象写入 Key。
description.en: Writes keys into prefab objects inside an isolated scene.

description.zh: 在当前已加载场景中给对象写入 Key 并记脏。
description.en: Writes keys into objects of loaded scenes and marks them dirty.

description.zh: 给单个对象补 LocalizedText 并赋 Key。
description.en: Adds LocalizedText to one object and assigns its key.

description.zh: 按 7 列固定表头（Key,Description,ChineseSimplified,ChineseTraditional,English,Japanese,Korean）导出/导入本地化 CSV：引号包裹与转义、逐行解析、按 Key 更新或新增条目。导出默认目录为 Assets/Excel/Chaos_localization_excel。
description.en: Exports and imports localization CSV with the fixed 7-column header (Key, Description, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, English, Japanese, Korean): quote escaping, per-line parsing, and updating or adding entries by key. The default export folder is Assets/Excel/Chaos_localization_excel.

description.zh: CSV 导出/导入与解析转义所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding CSV export/import, parsing and escaping.

description.zh: 把当前配置导出为 7 列 UTF-8 CSV。
description.en: Exports the current config as a 7-column UTF-8 CSV.

description.zh: 从 CSV 读入并按 Key 新增或更新条目。
description.en: Reads a CSV and adds or updates entries by key.

description.zh: 解析含引号转义的 CSV 行。
description.en: Parses one CSV line with quoted-field escapes.

description.zh: 转义单元格内的引号，避免写坏 CSV。
description.en: Escapes quotes inside a cell so the CSV stays valid.

description.zh: 右栏条目编辑器：按语言展开的字段编辑、单条/全部清空、完整与缺失翻译计数，以及配置资产的新建/打开/保存与新增条目。
description.en: Right-panel entry editor: per-language field editing, clearing one entry or all entries, complete/missing translation counts, plus creating, opening and saving the config asset and adding new entries.

description.zh: 字段编辑、清空与数据生命周期所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding field editing, clearing and asset lifecycle.

description.zh: 绘制单条本地化条目的完整编辑区。
description.en: Draws the full editor for one localization entry.

description.zh: 绘制单语言字段与清空按钮。
description.en: Draws one language field with its clear button.

description.zh: 清空全部条目的当前语言内容。
description.en: Clears the current language text of all entries.

description.zh: 保存当前编辑的本地化配置资产。
description.en: Saves the currently edited localization config asset.

description.zh: 本地化编辑器主窗口：左栏搜索与条目列表（按语言显示缺失/完整度）、右栏编辑区、可拖拽分隔条与样式初始化；静默模式跳过清空确认。
description.en: Main localization editor window: left column with search and entry list (per-language completeness), right column editor area, draggable splitter and style setup; silent mode skips the clear-all confirmation.

description.zh: 窗口外壳、左右面板与分隔条所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding the window shell, panels and splitter.

description.zh: 打开本地化编辑器窗口的菜单项。
description.en: Menu item opening the localization editor window.

description.zh: 打开本地化编辑器窗口。
description.en: Opens the localization editor window.

description.zh: 静默开关：自动化驱动时跳过确认框。
description.en: Silent switch: skips confirmation dialogs under automation.

description.zh: 绘制左栏搜索框与条目列表。
description.en: Draws the left search box and entry list.

description.zh: 为每种语言指定 TMP 字体资产并核对覆盖率：按语言探测字符集、报告字体缺失字形，然后把映射批量套到 UI 预制体上。注意 LanguageFontMap.asset 在 Assets/Data 下（不在 Resources），运行时只能靠组件引用。
description.en: Assigns a TMP font asset per language and checks coverage: probes per-language characters, reports missing glyphs, then patches UI prefabs in bulk. Note LanguageFontMap.asset lives under Assets/Data (not Resources), so runtime only reaches it through component references.

description.zh: 字体映射窗口与覆盖率探测所在文件。
description.en: The font map window and coverage probing.

description.zh: 打开语言字体映射窗口的菜单项。
description.en: Menu item opening the language font map window.

description.zh: 重新收集工程内可用的 TMP 字体资产。
description.en: Re-collects available TMP font assets in the project.

description.zh: 统计某字体对某语言字符集的覆盖情况。
description.en: Reports a font's coverage over a language character set.

description.zh: 把字体映射批量应用到 UI 预制体。
description.en: Applies the font map to UI prefabs in bulk.

description.zh: 编辑期按模块拆在 Assets/Data/Localization/Sub_LD，运行期只读一张整表：本工具整份重建合并产物 ChaosLocalizationConfig.asset（先清空旧条目再按子配置全量重写，幂等、无孤儿条目）。窗口展示每个子配置的条目数与告警。
description.en: Sub-configs are split per module under Assets/Data/Localization/Sub_LD while runtime reads a single table: this tool rebuilds ChaosLocalizationConfig.asset from scratch (clears old entries, rewrites everything, idempotent, no orphans). The window lists per-file entry counts and warnings.

description.zh: 合并器窗口与合并实现所在文件。
description.en: The merger window and merge implementation.

description.zh: 打开子配置合并窗口的菜单项。
description.en: Menu item opening the sub-config merger window.

description.zh: 把所有子配置合并成运行期整表（可 dryRun）。
description.en: Merges all sub-configs into the runtime table (dryRun supported).

description.zh: 静默开关：脚本驱动时不弹模态框。
description.en: Silent switch: no modal dialogs under automation.

description.zh: 合并产物路径常量 ChaosLocalizationConfig.asset。
description.en: Constant path of the merged output asset.

name.zh: Scene 视图 UI 分离

description.zh: Scene 视图 UI 分离显示：把满屏 Canvas 从场景区摘到左侧独立预览面板，含对象级隐藏、非 UI 渲染器抑制、临时激活停用面板，以及 Library 隐藏账本（强杀后自愈）。
description.en: Scene-view UI separation: extracts full-screen canvases into a left preview panel, with visibility management, non-UI renderer suppression, temporary activation of inactive panels, and a Library-based hidden ledger that self-heals after a forced restart.

description.zh: 隐藏对象的持久记忆：Library 下的账本（与 SceneVisibilityState 同寿命）记录场景路径与层级路径，工具被强杀时按账本自愈，场景打开时查账本。同时包含暴露开关的 Scene 视图 Overlay。
description.en: Persistent memory for hidden canvases: the ledger under Library (same lifetime as SceneVisibilityState) records scene path plus hierarchy path, is healed when the tool was killed while enabled, and is consulted on scene open. Also holds the Scene-view Overlay exposing the toggle.

description.zh: 隐藏账本与 Overlay 入口所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding the hidden ledger and the overlay entry.

description.zh: 写入本工具隐藏的 Canvas 账本。
description.en: Writes the ledger of canvases hidden by this tool.

description.zh: 按账本修复强杀后遗留的孤儿隐藏对象。
description.en: Heals orphan hidden canvases recorded in the ledger.

description.zh: 按场景内层级路径查找 Transform。
description.en: Finds a transform by scene path.

description.zh: 构建 Scene 视图 Overlay 面板内容。
description.en: Builds the Scene-view overlay panel content.

description.zh: 工具状态与可见性：静态 InitializeOnLoad 入口、基于 SessionState 的开启开关与变更事件、根 Canvas 收集、用 SceneVisibilityManager 做对象级隐藏/还原（不按 Layer，因为面板预制体在 Default 层），以及场景打开时接管隐藏对象。
description.en: Tool state and visibility: static InitializeOnLoad entry, SessionState-backed enabled flag with change event, root-canvas discovery, hide/restore through SceneVisibilityManager (object-level, not layer-based, because panel prefabs stay on the Default layer), and adoption of hidden canvases after a scene opens.

description.zh: 工具开关状态、隐藏与可见性接管所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding tool state, hiding and visibility adoption.

apis.path: Menu/Tool/UI/UI 与场景分离显示（Scene 视图）

description.zh: 读写持久化的开启状态。

description.zh: 开启状态变化时触发的事件。

description.zh: 用 SceneVisibilityManager 隐藏根 Canvas。
description.en: Hides root canvases via SceneVisibilityManager.

description.zh: 还原先前隐藏的 Canvas。

description.en: Preview panel rendering: draws world bounds and the panel frame, renders root canvases into a RenderTexture through a normal camera (PreviewRenderUtility cannot see scene canvases), switches overlay canvases to a probe camera, suppresses non-UI renderers, and temporarily activates inactive panels before restoring them.

description.zh: 预览面板、相机配置与抑制所在行段。
description.en: Line range holding the preview panel, camera setup and suppression.

description.zh: 绘制带包围盒与关闭按钮的左侧预览面板。
description.en: Draws the left preview panel with bounds and close button.

description.zh: 把预览相机对准指定根 Canvas。
description.en: Points the preview camera at a root canvas.

description.zh: 抑制遮住预览的非 UI 渲染器。
description.en: Suppresses non-UI renderers occluding the preview.

description.zh: 渲染前临时激活停用的面板。
description.en: Temporarily activates inactive panels for rendering.

description.zh: 存放在 Assets/Editor 下的 Spine 编辑器设置资产：默认缩放、混合、着色器、Z 间距、实例化循环、层级图标、贴图导入策略，以及 multiply/screen/additive 混合模式材质。由 Spine 插件消费，不由工程代码读取。
description.en: Spine's editor settings asset stored under Assets/Editor: default scale, mix, shader, Z spacing, instantiate loop, hierarchy icons, texture importer policy and the multiply/screen/additive blend-mode materials. Consumed by the Spine plugin, not by project code.

description.zh: Spine 编辑器设置资产（导入骨架的默认值）。
description.en: Spine editor settings asset (defaults for imported skeletons).

name.zh: 面板动画组件批量工具

description.en: One-shot editor tool that materialises panel entrance/exit animation components into the prefabs: runtime auto-added components are never saved, so their inspector values stay at field defaults. Loads each panel prefab in isolation, skips non-BasePanel or already-equipped objects, saves in bulk under a single asset-editing scope.

description.zh: 批量面板预制体动画组件工具所在文件。
description.en: The batch panel-prefab animator component tool.

apis.path: Menu/Tool/UI/为所有面板预制体添加动画组件

description.en: Dialogue playback internals: typewriter coroutine, auto-skip coroutine, option button spawning/clearing, option selection and DialogueEvent dispatch.

description.zh: 打字机、自动跳过、选项 UI 与事件分发实现段。
description.en: Typewriter, auto-skip, options UI and event dispatch internals.

description.zh: 事件体系：EventManager 字符串事件总线（AddListener/RemoveListener/TriggerEvent/Clear）与 TriggerEvent 扩展方法、EventConstName 事件名常量、CustomEventArgs 事件参数族，以及已标记 Obsolete 的旧 EventCenter（引用即编译错误）。
description.en: Event stack: the EventManager string-keyed bus (Add/Remove/Trigger/Clear) with the TriggerEvent extension method, the EventConstName constants, the CustomEventArgs family, and the obsolete EventCenter (referencing it is a compile error).

description.zh: 事件中心参数族：InputArgs、存档/加载与设置事件参数、加载进度参数、委派任务参数，均继承 EventArgs。
description.en: EventArgs family for the event bus: InputArgs, Saving/LoadingEventArgs, Saving/LoadingSettingEventArgs, LoadingProgressEventArgs, DelegateQuestEventArgs.

description.en: InputManager: loads the InputActionAsset (Player map, Move/Attack/Jump), override JSON persistence, per-part reset, key display names and control-key parsing, the full rebinding flow (step split, listening, conflict clearing, cancel), and key-event polling.

description.en: LocalizationManager init and switching: loads saved language, builds the text cache, ChangeLanguage and the OnLanguageChanged UnityEvent.

description.zh: 当前语言。

description.en: Event raised after the language changed.

description.zh: 按键取本地化文本。
description.en: Gets localized text by key.

description.zh: 按键判断是否存在。
description.en: Checks whether a key exists.

description.zh: 运行时替换本地化配置并刷新。
description.en: Replaces the localization data asset at runtime.

description.en: All supported languages.

description.zh: SettingKeys：设置面板选项的本地化 Key 表（窗口模式/画质/触发方式/语言）与按设置 id 取表的查询入口。
description.en: SettingKeys: localization keys for setting panel options (window mode, quality, trigger mode, language) and the id-to-table lookup.

description.en: Mouse trigger-mode option keys.

description.zh: 语言选项 Key 表。
description.en: Language option keys.

description.zh: LocalizedTextFont 订阅侧：挂接语言切换事件，暴露 Subscribed 标记与事件计数用于自检。
description.en: LocalizedTextFont subscription side: hooks the language-changed event, exposes Subscribed and an event counter for self-checking.

description.zh: 组件是否已订阅语言切换。
description.en: Whether the component is subscribed to language changes.

description.zh: 语言切换事件计数（供自检）。
description.en: Language-change event counter (self-check).

description.zh: 是否在语言切换时自动应用字体。
description.en: Whether the font is applied on language change.

description.zh: 字体应用：解析映射表（组件指定/生效表/Resources 回退）、切换 TMP 字体资源，并对缺项给出告警与自检。
description.en: Font application: resolves the map (component/active/Resources fallback), switches TMP font assets and validates the map with warnings.

description.zh: 按当前语言应用字体。
description.en: Applies the font for the current language.

description.zh: 强制重新应用字体。
description.en: Forces a font re-apply.

description.zh: 字体解析、切换与自检实现段。
description.en: Font resolution, switching and self-check block.

description.zh: ChaosLog 日志体系：分级（Debug/Info/Success/Warn/Error）与频道着色（LogChannel/LogColor）、调用点与内联堆栈、富文本构建器 LogBuilder、开关与等级配置、以及编辑器/运行时初始化引导 LogBootstrap。
description.en: ChaosLog stack: level filtering (Debug/Info/Success/Warn/Error) with channel colors (LogChannel/LogColor), call-site and inline stack traces, the fluent rich-text LogBuilder, global switches/level config, and LogBootstrap for editor/runtime initialization.

description.zh: LogBootstrap：以 RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod 与编辑器 InitializeOnLoadMethod 在启动时套用 ChaosLog 默认配置。
description.en: LogBootstrap: RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod plus an editor InitializeOnLoadMethod that configure ChaosLog defaults on startup.

description.zh: 编辑器与运行时日志初始化引导脚本。
description.en: Editor/runtime log initialization bootstrap script.

description.zh: LogBuilder 链式构建：频道、上下文、堆栈与颜色（含 White/Gray/Red 等具名颜色快捷方法）。
description.en: LogBuilder fluent chain: channel, context, trace and color helpers (named colors via White/Gray/Red/... one-liners).

description.zh: LogBuilder 终结方法：Emit 与按等级输出。Emit 会反向回调 ChaosLog.Emit（为避免依赖成环，该反向箭头只在描述里记录）。
description.en: LogBuilder terminals: Emit plus per-level shortcuts that finish the chain and print the line. Emit calls back into ChaosLog.Emit (reverse edge omitted to keep the graph acyclic).

description.en: Emits as Warn.

description.en: Emits as Error.

description.zh: LogChannel 频道枚举（通用/网络/UI/音频/配置/对话/本地化/输入/对象池/场景/存档/战斗/编辑器）与名称、颜色两张对照表。
description.en: LogChannel enum (General/Network/UI/Audio/Config/Dialogue/Localization/Input/Pool/Scene/Save/Battle/Editor) with name and color tables.

description.en: Pre-built colored [Channel] rich-text fragment.

description.zh: LogColor 颜色枚举与 LogColorInfo 十六进制色表，供链式构建的具名颜色快捷方法使用。
description.en: LogColor enum plus LogColorInfo hex table, used by the fluent builder's named color shortcuts.

description.zh: 取 LogColor 对应的十六进制颜色。
description.en: Returns the hex color of a LogColor value.

description.zh: LogColor 枚举与十六进制色表脚本。
description.en: LogColor enum and hex table script asset.

description.zh: ChaosLog 开关配置：总开关、Debug 开关、最低等级（编辑器 Debug / 发布 Warn）、调用点与时间戳显示。
description.en: ChaosLog switches: Enabled, EnableDebug, MinLevel (Debug in editor / Warn in release), call-site and timestamp toggles.

description.zh: 日志总开关。
description.en: Master switch for all logging.

description.zh: 是否输出 Debug 级日志。
description.en: Enables Debug-level logs.

description.en: Minimum level that gets emitted.

description.zh: 是否显示调用点。
description.en: Whether call-site info is shown.

description.zh: 是否显示时间戳。
description.en: Whether timestamps are shown.

description.zh: ChaosLog 输出核心：等级过滤、频道与颜色拼接、调用点截取、内联堆栈展开与线程安全构建器。
description.en: ChaosLog emit core: level filtering, channel/color formatting, call-site extraction, inline stack traces and the threaded builder.

description.zh: 开始一条链式日志（Write(...).Channel().Color().Info()）。
description.en: Starts a fluent log line (Write(...).Channel().Color().Info()).

description.zh: 日志输出管线、等级前缀与内联堆栈实现段。
description.en: Emit pipeline, level prefix, inline trace block.

description.zh: ChaosLog 分级快捷方法：Debug/Info/Success/Warn/WarnTrace/Error，各自带频道、上下文对象与调用者信息重载。
description.en: ChaosLog level shortcuts: Debug/Info/Success/Warn/WarnTrace/Error, each with optional channel, context and caller info overloads.

description.zh: Debug 级日志（仅编辑器/开发版）。
description.en: Debug-level log (editor/dev only).

description.zh: Info 级日志。
description.en: Info-level log.

description.zh: Success 级日志。
description.en: Success-level log.

description.zh: Warn 级日志。
description.en: Warn-level log.

description.zh: Warn 级日志并强制附堆栈。
description.en: Warn-level log with a forced stack trace.

description.zh: Error 级日志。
description.en: Error-level log.

description.zh: Path&Type 目录：GlobalPath 全局路径常量（Resources 路径、Excel/Json/Record 落盘路径、存档槽位常量）与 PanelType 面板类型枚举。全工程资源加载与产物定位的单一事实源。
description.en: Path&Type folder: GlobalPath constants (Resources paths, Excel/Json/record output paths, save-slot constants) and the PanelType panel enum. Single source of truth for resource loading and artifact locations.

description.zh: GlobalPath 全局常量：Resources 子路径、Excel/Json/.record 落盘路径、UI 预制体搜索路径、本地化配置路径与存档槽位常量。工程内路径定位的单一事实源。
description.en: GlobalPath constants: Resources sub-paths, Excel/Json/record output paths, UI prefab search paths, save-slot constants. Single source of truth for paths.

description.en: Panel prefab search path list.

description.zh: PanelType 面板类型枚举（主菜单/保存/设置/暂停/状态/对话/任务/读条/存档/结局等 13 项），UIManager 据此动态拼路径并实例化面板。
description.en: PanelType enum (MainMenuPanel, SavePanel, SettingPanel, SLPanel, ProgressPanel...). Drives dynamic panel path building.

description.zh: 13 个面板类型枚举值，用于辅助拼面板预制体路径。
description.en: 13 panel-type enum values used to build panel prefab paths.

description.zh: PoolManager 对象池：按名字分池（PoolData 持有池根节点与空闲列表），GetObj 从池取或经 ResManager 异步实例化、PushObj 回收、Clear 清空；注意 GetObj 返回值恒为 null，实例通过回调交付。
description.en: PoolManager: pools keyed by name (PoolData holds the pool root and free list); GetObj reuses from the pool or instantiates via ResManager, PushObj returns objects, Clear empties all. Note GetObj always returns null — the instance is delivered through the callback.

description.zh: PoolData 单个对象池：持有池根节点与空闲列表，提供取用与归还。
description.en: PoolData: one named pool holding its root GameObject and free list, with take/return helpers.

description.zh: 从本池取一个对象。
description.en: Pops one object from this pool.

description.zh: 把对象放回本池。
description.en: Pushes one object back into this pool.

description.zh: 池根节点。
description.en: Pool root GameObject in the hierarchy.

description.zh: PoolManager 对象池管理：按名字分池，GetObj 复用或经 ResManager 实例化，PushObj 回收，Clear 清空。已知缺陷：GetObj 返回值恒为 null。
description.en: PoolManager: dictionary of named pools, GetObj reuses or loads via ResManager, PushObj returns, Clear empties. Known defect: GetObj returns null.

description.zh: 从池取或异步实例化；返回值恒为 null，实例通过回调交付。
description.en: Takes an object from the pool or instantiates one; returns null, delivers via callback.

description.zh: 把对象归还到对应池。
description.en: Returns an object to its pool.

description.zh: 清空全部对象池。
description.en: Clears all pools.

description.zh: ResManager：对 Resources.Load / LoadAsync 的薄封装，同步 Load<T> 与异步 LoadAsync<T>（回调交付），加载失败打 error 日志；注意 Load<GameObject> 内部已 Instantiate。
description.en: ResManager: a thin wrapper over Resources.Load/LoadAsync with synchronous Load<T> and callback-based LoadAsync<T> plus error logging on failure. Note Load<GameObject> already instantiates the prefab.

description.zh: ResManager：对 Resources.Load/LoadAsync 的薄封装并打错误日志。注意 Load<GameObject> 内部已经 Instantiate。
description.en: ResManager: thin Resources.Load/LoadAsync wrapper with error logging. Note Load<GameObject> already instantiates the prefab.

description.zh: 同步加载 Resources 资源。
description.en: Synchronously loads a Resources asset.

description.zh: 异步加载 Resources 资源并回调。
description.en: Asynchronously loads a Resources asset with a callback.

description.zh: 资源加载器脚本。
description.en: Resources loader script asset.

description.zh: 存档槽位体系：SaveSlotService 固定 1/2/3 三槽（读元信息与负载、写槽、新建、删除、找第一个非空槽、损坏槽降级）、SaveSlotMeta/SavePayload/SaveSlotFile/SaveSlotInfo 数据结构，以及跨场景会话单例 GameSession（当前槽、负载、目标场景名）。
description.en: Save-slot stack: SaveSlotService with fixed slots 1/2/3 (read meta+payload, write, create, delete, find first non-empty, corrupt-slot fallback), the SaveSlotMeta/SavePayload/SaveSlotFile/SaveSlotInfo data types, and the cross-scene GameSession singleton (current slot, payload, target scene).

description.zh: SaveSlotService 读取侧：目录解析与创建、槽位校验、路径拼装、ReadAllSlots 恒返 3 项、TryLoad 读槽并对损坏文件降级。
description.en: SaveSlotService read side: directory resolution, slot validation, path building, ReadAllSlots (always 3) and TryLoad with corrupt-file fallback.

description.zh: persistentDataPath 下的 Saves 目录。
description.en: Saves directory under persistentDataPath.

description.zh: 校验槽位下标是否合法（1-3）。
description.en: Validates a slot index (1-3).

description.zh: 拼出某槽位的文件路径。
description.en: Builds the file path of a slot.

description.zh: 读取全部三个槽（恒返回 3 项）。
description.en: Reads all three slots (always returns 3 items).

description.zh: 尝试读取槽文件（损坏时安全降级）。
description.en: Tries to load a slot file (corrupt falls back safely).

description.zh: SaveSlotService 写入侧：Save 写槽并刷新时间、CreateNew 新建、Delete 删除、找第一个非空槽、磁盘存在性判定，并对外来文件名告警忽略。
description.en: SaveSlotService write side: Save/CreateNew/Delete, first non-empty slot lookup and disk existence check, plus foreign-file warnings on disk.

description.zh: 把负载写入槽位并刷新最后保存时间。
description.en: Writes a payload into a slot (updates meta ticks).

description.zh: 在槽位创建一份新存档。
description.en: Creates a new empty save in a slot.

description.zh: 删除槽位文件。
description.en: Deletes a slot file.

description.zh: 查找第一个非空槽（全空返回 1）。
description.en: Finds the first non-empty slot (else 1).

description.zh: 槽文件是否存在于磁盘。
description.en: Whether a slot file exists on disk.

description.zh: GameSession 跨场景会话单例：携带当前存档槽、已加载负载、目标场景名与 HasSession 标记，用于读档后跨场景传递。
description.en: GameSession: cross-scene singleton carrying the selected slot, loaded payload, target scene name and HasSession flag.

description.zh: 用槽位、负载与目标场景开始会话。
description.en: Starts a session with slot, payload and target scene.

description.zh: 只设置待切换的目标场景名。
description.en: Sets only the pending target scene name.

description.zh: 清空会话。
description.en: Clears the session.

description.zh: 当前选中的槽位序号。
description.en: Currently selected slot index.

description.zh: 存档数据结构：SaveSlotMeta（槽位、最后保存 UTC ticks、版本）、SavePayload、SaveSlotFile 文件封装与运行时 SaveSlotInfo 视图。
description.en: Save file data types: SaveSlotMeta (index, last save ticks, version), SavePayload, SaveSlotFile and the runtime SaveSlotInfo view.

description.zh: 该槽是否有可用存档（非空且未损坏）。
description.en: Whether the slot holds a usable (non-empty, non-corrupt) save.

description.zh: 槽位序号字段（1-3）。
description.en: Slot index field (1-3).

description.zh: 存档负载版本字段。
description.en: Payload schema version field.

description.zh: 槽文件内的元信息块。
description.en: Metadata block inside a slot file.

description.en: Setting-panel row widgets: the SettingRowBase abstract base (child lookup, clickable/interactable state, disabled tinting) plus button, toggle, slider, selector and keybinding rows; keybinding rows support two slots and listening state, with KeyIconText for icon+text display.

description.zh: SettingRowBase 抽象基类：按名字找子节点、可点击/可交互状态与禁用配色、settingId 字段与 Inspector 自检。
description.en: SettingRowBase abstract class: child lookup helpers, clickable/interactable state with disabled tinting, and the settingId field.

description.zh: 第二槽位请求改键。

description.zh: 本行是否具有第二槽位。
description.en: Whether the row has a second binding slot.

description.en: Keybind row display: pushes text/icon/tint into the KeyIconText children of both slots.

description.zh: 设置主槽位按键文本。
description.en: Sets the primary slot's key text.

description.zh: 设置主槽位的文本/图标/颜色。
description.en: Sets the primary slot's text/icon/tint.

description.en: Sets the second slot's key text.

description.zh: 设置第二槽位的文本/图标/颜色。
description.en: Sets the second slot's text/icon/tint.

description.zh: 改键行监听态：改键中显示等待提示，含可点击/可交互重写与按钮回调绑定。

description.zh: 切换主槽位的监听态并显示提示文案。

description.en: Selector state block: silent index/text setters, stepping with clamping, option counting and display refresh.

description.zh: 静默设置选中下标。

description.zh: 静默设置显示文本。

description.en: Selector state/refresh implementation block.

description.zh: SettingRow_Slider 整数滑条行（如鼠标灵敏度）：范围配置、静默赋值与值变化回调。
description.en: SettingRow_Slider: integer slider row (e.g. mouse sensitivity) with range configuration and silent set.

description.en: SettingRow_Toggle: boolean setting row (e.g. vSync) with value-changed callback and silent set.

description.zh: 开关值变化回调。
description.en: Value-changed callback.

description.en: Sets the value without raising the callback.

description.zh: 重写可点击状态处理。
description.en: Overrides clickable state handling.

description.zh: 设置体系：SettingsData 可序列化存档模型（画面/声音/玩法/按键段）、SettingsManager 单例（读取落盘、Pending/Applied 编辑会话、提交后应用到硬件与各管理器）、SettingIds 键名常量、SettingsEnums 选项枚举与中文标签、ResolutionHelper 分辨率预设与挑选。
description.en: Settings stack: the SettingsData serializable model (graphics/audio/gameplay/keybind sections), the SettingsManager singleton (disk IO, pending/applied edit session, apply to runtime), SettingIds key constants, SettingsEnums option enums and labels, and ResolutionHelper resolution presets/picking.

description.zh: SettingsData 可写存档模型：版本号与画面/声音/玩法/按键各字段，提供默认值构造、克隆、内容比较与按分类重置。
description.en: SettingsData serializable model: versioned fields for graphics/audio/gameplay/keybind sections, plus CreateDefault, Clone, ContentEquals and per-section reset.

description.zh: 创建一份默认值设置对象。
description.en: Creates a settings object with default values.

description.zh: 深拷贝一份设置对象。
description.en: Deep-copies the settings object.

description.zh: 逐字段比较内容是否一致。
description.en: Compares content field by field.

description.zh: 把某一分类段重置为默认值。
description.en: Resets one section to defaults.

description.zh: 存档结构版本字段，用于兼容。
description.en: Schema version field for save compatibility.

description.zh: 设置选项枚举：窗口模式/帧率/输入设备/手柄型号/画质/设置分类，配 InputScheme 映射与 SettingsLabels 中文标签表。
description.en: Settings option enums (window mode, frame rate, input device, gamepad model, quality, category) with InputScheme mapping helpers and SettingsLabels tables.

description.zh: 判断某设备取值是否属于手柄。
description.en: Whether a device value means gamepad input.

description.zh: 手柄型号→设备类型。
description.en: Maps a gamepad model to a device type.
