description.en: Maps a device type to a gamepad model.

description.zh: 按下标安全取标签表项。
description.en: Safely reads a label table by index.

description.zh: 取手柄按键的中文名。
description.en: Localized gamepad button name.

description.zh: 设置选项枚举与中文标签表。
description.en: Option enums and label tables for settings rows.

description.zh: SettingIds 设置项 id 常量（graphics.* / audio.* / gameplay.* / keybind.*）：设置行按 id 绑定到 SettingsData 字段的唯一契约。
description.en: SettingIds: stable string ids for every setting row (graphics.*, audio.*, gameplay.*, keybind.*) used to bind UI rows to settings.

description.zh: 语言设置项 id。
description.en: Language setting id.

description.zh: 分辨率设置项 id。
description.en: Resolution setting id.

description.zh: 主音量设置项 id。
description.en: Master volume setting id.

description.zh: 左移按键设置项 id。
description.en: Move-left keybinding setting id.

description.zh: 重置按键方案设置项 id。
description.en: Reset-scheme setting id.

description.zh: SettingsManager 状态与初始化：单例建立、Applied/Pending 双快照、编辑中标记与脏数据判定，供设置页读写。
description.en: SettingsManager state and init: singleton setup, Applied/Pending snapshots, editing flag and dirty check for the settings page.

description.zh: 初始化并读取设置。
description.en: Initializes and loads settings.

description.zh: 已生效设置（权威）。
description.en: Applied settings (authoritative).

description.zh: 编辑中的待提交设置。
description.en: Pending settings while editing.

description.zh: 是否处于编辑会话中。
description.en: Whether an edit session is open.

description.zh: 待提交与已生效是否存在差异。
description.en: Whether pending differs from applied.

description.zh: 设置应用：把已生效设置推给 QualitySettings、音频管理器、输入覆盖项与本地化管理器，含选项映射辅助。
description.en: Settings application: pushes applied settings into QualitySettings, AudioManager, InputManager overrides and LocalizationManager, plus option mapping helpers.

description.zh: 把设置对象应用到画面/声音/输入/本地化。
description.en: Applies a settings object to graphics, audio, input and localization.

description.zh: 窗口模式选项→FullScreenMode。
description.en: Maps the window-mode option to FullScreenMode.

description.zh: 画质选项→质量等级下标。
description.en: Maps the quality option to a quality level index.

description.zh: 设置编辑会话：BeginEdit 建待编辑副本、CommitEdit 提交落盘、RevertEdit 丢弃、按分类重置与变更通知。
description.en: Settings edit session: BeginEdit/CommitEdit/RevertEdit with a pending copy, per-section reset and pending-changed notification.

description.zh: 把已生效设置拷贝为待编辑副本。
description.en: Copies applied settings into the pending edit copy.

description.zh: 提交待编辑设置、落盘并结束会话。
description.en: Applies pending settings, saves and closes the session.

description.zh: 丢弃待提交更改。
description.en: Discards pending changes.

description.zh: 把待编辑的某分类段重置为默认。
description.en: Resets one pending section to defaults.

description.zh: 广播待编辑变更事件。
description.en: Raises the OnPendingChanged event.

description.zh: 设置持久化：读写 persistentDataPath/Config/settings.json，含首次运行自动适配与 SaveSetting/LoadSetting 事件广播。
description.en: Settings persistence: Load/Save to persistentDataPath/Config/settings.json with first-run auto detection and SaveSetting/LoadSetting events.

description.zh: 从磁盘读取设置（含首次运行自动检测）。
description.en: Loads settings from disk (with first-run auto detect).

description.zh: 写盘并抛出设置事件。
description.en: Saves settings to disk and raises events.

description.zh: settings.json 路径（persistentDataPath/Config）。
description.en: settings.json path under persistentDataPath.

description.zh: ResolutionHelper 分辨率工具：内置预设、显示器最大值、可用选项构建、下标查找/最接近匹配与最佳可用挑选。
description.en: ResolutionHelper: built-in presets, display max resolution, available-option building, index lookup/closest match and best-available picking.

description.zh: 内置分辨率预设数量。
description.en: Number of built-in resolution presets.

description.zh: 按下标取预设。
description.en: Gets a preset by index.

description.zh: 取显示器最大分辨率。
description.en: Gets the display's max resolution.

description.zh: 构建可用分辨率选项列表。
description.en: Builds the available resolution option list.

description.zh: 挑选当前可用的最佳分辨率。
description.en: Picks the best available resolution.

description.zh: UIManager 面板栈（按 PanelType 动态实例化/压栈/出栈，Canvas 按名字查找）与 BasePanel 面板基类（显隐、光标、暂停）。另含 TangLaoShi 命名空间下已废置的旧基类/旧管理器。
description.en: UIManager panel stack (instantiates panels by PanelType, push/pop, finds Canvas by name) plus BasePanel (show/hide, cursor, pause). Also holds the obsolete TangLaoShi-namespace legacy base class and manager.

description.zh: UIPanelAnimator：基于 DOTween 的面板进场/退场动画（淡入淡出、四向滑入、缩放）、静止状态录制、子元素依次入场（Stagger）与输入遮罩；配套 PanelAnimType 动画类型枚举与 UIPanelStaggerItem 标记组件。
description.en: UIPanelAnimator: DOTween-based panel enter/exit animations (fade, slide from four sides, scale), rest-state capture, staggered child entrance, and input blocking; with the PanelAnimType enum and the UIPanelStaggerItem marker component.

description.zh: PanelAnimType 枚举：每个值描述“起始状态”，静止状态由录制得来，同一个值既可进场也可反向退场。
description.en: PanelAnimType enum used by UIPanelAnimator; each value describes the start pose and also drives exit in reverse.

description.zh: 面板动画类型枚举（None/Fade/四向 Slide/大小 Scale），数值显式指定、新成员只能追加。
description.en: Panel animation type enum (None/Fade/Slide/Scale), explicit int values.

description.zh: UIPanelAnimator 的 Inspector 配置与运行时状态：进场/退场类型与缓动、滑入距离、依次入场参数、过渡期输入遮罩、播放状态。
description.en: UIPanelAnimator inspector configuration: enter/exit types, easing, slide distance, stagger settings, input blocking and runtime state.

description.zh: 进场动画类型（序列化字段）。
description.en: Enter animation type (serialized field).

description.zh: 退场动画类型（序列化字段）。
description.en: Exit animation type (serialized field).

description.zh: 是否启用子元素依次入场。
description.en: Whether staggered child entrance is enabled.

description.zh: 当前是否有动画在播放。
description.en: Whether an animation is currently playing.

description.zh: 动画公开接口：PlayEnter/PlayExit 播放与立即落位、KillTweens 中断、SnapToRest 贴回、RecaptureRest 重新录制静止状态。
description.en: Public animation API: PlayEnter/PlayExit, KillTweens, SnapToRest and RecaptureRest (rest pose recording).

description.zh: 播放进场动画（instant 直接落位）。
description.en: Plays the enter animation (instant skips tweens).

description.zh: 播放退场动画（instant 直接落位）。
description.en: Plays the exit animation (instant skips tweens).

description.zh: 杀掉所有正在跑的补间。
description.en: Kills all running tweens.

description.zh: 立即贴回录制的静止状态。
description.en: Snaps the panel to its recorded rest pose.

description.zh: 把当前姿态重新录制为静止状态。
description.en: Recaptures the current pose as the rest state.

description.zh: UIPanelAnimator 内部实现：初始化与静止状态录制、位移目标同步、起始姿态计算（SlideX/SlideY）与补间序列构建。
description.en: UIPanelAnimator internals: initialization, rest-state capture, move-target sync, pose computation (slide X/Y) and tween sequence building.

description.zh: 静止状态录制、起始姿态计算与补间构建等内部实现段。
description.en: Rest-pose capture, pose computation, tween building internals.

description.zh: UIPanelAnimator 依次入场实现：收集 staggerRoot 子物体或 UIPanelStaggerItem 标记项，按 order/层级与 staggerInterval 构建逐项补间，并维护项缓存。
description.en: UIPanelAnimator stagger internals: collects marked/child items, builds per-item tweens with interval ordering, and prunes the item cache.

description.zh: 子元素依次入场的实现段（收集项、构建序列、缓存与清理）。
description.en: Staggered child entrance implementation block.

description.zh: UIPanelStaggerItem 标记组件：挂在需要参与依次入场的子物体上，可自定义先后顺序；一旦子树中存在该标记，就只动被标记项。
description.en: UIPanelStaggerItem: optional marker placed on children that should participate in staggered entrance with a custom order.

description.zh: 本项的入场顺序（越小越先入场）。
description.en: Sort order for this item (smaller enters first).

description.zh: 可选的依次入场标记组件脚本。
description.en: Optional marker component script asset.

description.zh: BasePanel 面板基类：OnEnter/OnExit 生命周期钩子、Show/Hide 带显隐动画（可 instant）、Animator 属性暴露动画器。
description.en: BasePanel base class: OnEnter/OnExit hooks, Show/Hide with optional animation, and the cached Animator property.

description.zh: 面板显示时调用，子类重写。
description.en: Called when the panel is shown.

description.zh: 面板隐藏时调用，子类重写。
description.en: Called when the panel is hidden.

description.zh: 显示面板（可 instant 跳过动画）。
description.en: Shows the panel (optionally instantly) with animation.

description.zh: 隐藏面板（可 instant 跳过动画）。
description.en: Hides the panel (optionally instantly) with animation.

description.zh: 动画器访问属性（缓存的 UIPanelAnimator）。
description.en: Animator accessor (cached UIPanelAnimator).

description.zh: BasePanel 的光标与时间辅助：CursorEnable/CursorHide 控制鼠标、PauseTime/ResumeTime 控制 Time.timeScale、IsShowing 暴露显示状态。
description.en: BasePanel cursor and time helpers: CursorEnable/CursorHide, PauseTime/ResumeTime, and the IsShowing flag.

description.zh: 显示鼠标光标。
description.en: Shows the cursor.

description.zh: 隐藏鼠标光标。
description.en: Hides the cursor.

description.zh: 暂停/恢复游戏时间（本面板范围内）。
description.en: Pauses/unpauses game time for this panel.

description.zh: 恢复时间缩放。
description.en: Restores time scale.

description.zh: 面板当前是否显示中。
description.en: Whether the panel is currently showing.

description.zh: TangLaoShi 命名空间旧 UI 层：[Obsolete] 的 BasePanel（按名字查控件 GetControl<T>）与完全空壳的旧 UIManager。属死代码，无引用。
description.en: Legacy TangLaoShi namespace UI layer: an [Obsolete] BasePanel with GetControl<T> and a completely empty UIManager shell. Dead code, kept for history.

description.zh: 旧版 OnEnter 虚方法（已废弃）。
description.en: Legacy virtual enter hook (obsolete).

description.zh: 旧版 OnExit 虚方法（已废弃）。
description.en: Legacy virtual exit hook (obsolete).

description.zh: TangLaoShi 命名空间下已废弃的面板基类脚本。
description.en: Obsolete TangLaoShi base panel script asset.

description.zh: TangLaoShi 命名空间下空壳旧 UIManager（无任何成员）。
description.en: Empty obsolete TangLaoShi UIManager shell.

description.zh: UIManager 面板栈管理：按名字找 Canvas、按 PanelType 动态实例化面板、Push/Pop 栈式显隐、实例缓存复用。注意缓存导致 OnEnter 会多次触发。
description.en: UIManager: finds Canvas by name, instantiates panels by PanelType, keeps a panel stack with push/pop, and caches instances for reuse.

description.zh: 按名字找到 Canvas 并初始化面板字典。
description.en: Finds the Canvas by name and initializes the panel dictionary.

description.zh: 按 PanelType 显示面板并返回 BasePanel 实例。
description.en: Shows a panel by PanelType, returning the BasePanel instance.

description.zh: 弹出并隐藏栈顶面板。
description.en: Pops and hides the top panel.

description.zh: 实例化面板预制体（带缓存复用）。
description.en: Instantiates a panel prefab (cached for reuse).

description.zh: 公开的面板栈，持有已打开面板。
description.en: Public panel stack holding active panels.

description.zh: Assets/Scripts/Runtime/MVP 的视图层：View/ 下面板与子控件（MainMenuPanel、SettingPanel、SLPanel 与 5 个设置页、RecordCell）与 Model/DialogueRuntimeData.cs；Presenter/ 仍为空，面板走 View → Service 直连。生成的 ConfigData/ModelData 类归 config-pipeline。
description.en: The view layer under Assets/Scripts/Runtime/MVP: panels and sub-widgets in View/ (MainMenuPanel, SettingPanel, SLPanel with five settings pages, RecordCell) and Model/DialogueRuntimeData.cs; Presenter/ is still empty, so panels call services directly (View → Service). Generated ConfigData/ModelData classes live in config-pipeline.

description.zh: MVP 的模型层。目前只有一个人写的模型文件（DialogueRuntimeData）；生成的 ConfigData / ModelData 表刻意归属配置表管线，不属于本层。
description.en: The MVP model layer. Only one hand-written model file exists today (DialogueRuntimeData); the generated ConfigData and ModelData tables intentionally belong to the config-table pipeline, not to this layer.

description.zh: 命名空间 DialogueSystem 下的对话运行时数据：五个 [Serializable] DTO（对话/角色/条目/选项/事件），对应对话编辑器在运行时导出的结构。注意：当前工程里没有任何地方构造或消费这些类型，文件自成一体。
description.en: Dialogue runtime data in namespace DialogueSystem: five [Serializable] DTOs (runtime dialogue, character, entry, option, event) that mirror what the dialogue editor would export at runtime. Note: nothing in the project currently constructs or consumes these types — the file is self-contained.

description.zh: 对话条目列表与可跳过/自动播放/显示历史/暂停游戏等开关。
description.en: Dialogue entry list plus skip/autoplay flags.

description.zh: 角色 id、显示名、名字颜色、头像与语音路径。
description.en: Character id, name, colour, avatar and voice paths.

description.zh: 一条对话：文本、打字速度、语音、选项与事件。
description.en: One line: text, typing speed, voice, options, events.

description.zh: 玩家选项文本与跳转目标对话 id。
description.en: Player choice text and its jump target.

description.zh: 对话事件的名称与参数。
description.en: Name plus parameter of a dialogue event.

description.zh: 五个 [Serializable] 对话运行时 DTO。
description.en: The five serializable dialogue DTOs.

description.zh: 尚未引入的 Presenter 层占位。MVP 三件套里的这个目录存在但没有任何脚本：当前面板直连服务（View → Service）。好处是将来抽 Presenter 只需挪一层，不必改数据访问。空目录叶子按约定写 apis: []。
description.en: Placeholder for the not-yet-introduced Presenter layer. The folder exists in the MVP trio but has no script: panels currently talk to services directly (View to Service), so extracting presenters later is a pure move rather than a data-access rewrite.

description.zh: MVP/View 下的三个界面域：主菜单、设置（面板 + 5 个设置页）、存档读档（SLPanel + RecordCell 格子）。所有面板都继承框架的 BasePanel，由 UIManager 缓存并复用实例——所以 Awake 只跑一次、OnEnter 每次打开都跑。
description.en: The three UI domains under MVP/View: main menu, settings (panel plus five settings pages) and save/load (SLPanel plus the RecordCell slot widget). Every panel extends the framework BasePanel and is cached and reused by UIManager, so Awake runs once while OnEnter runs on every open.

description.zh: 主菜单面板：Awake 里绑定 StartBtn/UpdateBtn/SettingBtn/QuitBtn 四个按钮，点开始游戏按 PanelType 推入 SLPanel、点设置推入 SettingPanel。更新公告目前只打日志，退出直接 Application.Quit。
description.en: Main menu panel: binds StartBtn/UpdateBtn/SettingBtn/QuitBtn in Awake, then pushes SLPanel by PanelType when the player starts a game and SettingPanel when the player opens settings. Update announcement and Quit only log / call Application.Quit today.

description.zh: 按子节点名取四个按钮并注册点击监听。
description.en: Node lookup and button listener registration.

description.zh: 面板打开/关闭钩子（都只转调基类）。
description.en: Panel enter/exit hooks (both call base).

description.zh: 面板被 UIManager 推入并打开时调用。
description.en: Panel opened by UIManager (pushed onto the stack).

description.zh: 面板被关闭时调用。
description.en: Panel closed by UIManager.

description.zh: 开始游戏/更新公告/设置/退出四个按钮的行为。
description.en: Start/Update/Setting/Quit button behaviours.

description.zh: 存档读档界面：SLPanel 画固定 3 个档位并把玩家意图转成新建/读取/删除，RecordCell 是它只例化一次并长期复用的格子控件。两者都不碰文件系统——落盘统一走 SaveSlotService。
description.en: Save/load UI: SLPanel draws three fixed slots and turns player intent into create/load/delete, and RecordCell is the reusable slot widget it instantiates once and keeps. Neither touches the file system — all persistence goes through SaveSlotService.

description.zh: SLPanel（509 行）拆为五块：生命周期、节点查找与格子工厂、刷新与选中、共用的二次确认状态机、三个业务动作。因为 UIManager 会缓存并复用面板实例，绑定一律放 Awake 且幂等，OnEnter 只刷新。
description.en: SLPanel (509 lines) split into five: lifecycle, node lookup plus cell factory, refresh/selection, the shared confirm state machine, and the three business actions. Binding stays in Awake and is idempotent because UIManager caches and reuses the panel instance.

description.zh: 三个业务动作：空档位新建、读取档位（写 GameSession 后切到 LoadingScene，回调必须传非空委托——LoadScene 会无条件调 action()，传 null 必 NRE）、删除选中档位。落盘统一走 SaveSlotService。
description.en: The three save actions: create a new save in an empty slot, load a slot (write GameSession, then switch to LoadingScene with a non-null delegate — LoadScene invokes the callback unconditionally, so passing null would NRE), and delete the selected slot. All persistence goes through SaveSlotService.

description.zh: 空档位新建存档。
description.en: Creates a new save in an empty slot.

description.zh: 读取档位并切到读条场景进入游戏。
description.en: Loads a slot and enters the loading scene.

description.zh: 删除选中档位的存档。
description.en: Deletes the selected slot's save.

description.zh: 共用的二次确认浮层：空档位开始与删除复用同一个 ConfirmGroup，所以用 ConfirmPurpose 枚举记住「这次确认是为了什么」——没有状态机，OK 回调就不知道要执行新建还是删除。浮层可整组缺省，缺省时退化为直接执行。
description.en: The shared confirm overlay: create-from-empty and delete both reuse one ConfirmGroup, so a ConfirmPurpose enum records why it was opened — without it the OK callback could not tell whether to create or delete. The overlay is optional; when the prefab has no ConfirmGroup the panel degrades to acting immediately.

description.zh: 复用同一个确认浮层：显隐与文案设置。
description.en: Shows/hides the shared confirm group and its text.

description.zh: 确认/取消回调与 ExecuteConfirm 的分派。
description.en: Confirm callbacks and ExecuteConfirm dispatch.

description.zh: SLPanel 生命周期：Awake 找节点并建 3 个格子（只做一次），OnEnter 只调 Refresh，OnExit 不额外收尾。之所以守这条 R3 纪律，是因为 UIManager 复用缓存的面板实例——把 AddListener 或 Instantiate 放 OnEnter 会导致第 2 次打开就叠加回调、列表里堆重复格子。
description.en: SLPanel lifecycle: Awake binds nodes and builds the three cells exactly once, OnEnter only refreshes, OnExit does nothing else. The R3 discipline exists because UIManager reuses the cached panel — putting AddListener or Instantiate in OnEnter would stack duplicate listeners and duplicate cells on every open.

description.zh: 每次打开只刷新，不做绑定。
description.en: Refresh-on-open; binding never happens here.

description.zh: 面板被关闭时调用。
description.en: Panel closed by UIManager.

description.zh: Awake 绑定一次；OnEnter 只刷新（R3 纪律）。
description.en: Awake binds once; OnEnter only refreshes.

label.zh: 绑定与建格子只在 Awake
label.en: Bind and build cells in Awake

description.zh: 节点查找与格子工厂：按硬约定名字找 RecordsList / BottomBar / ConfirmGroup，EnsureCells 从 Resources 取 RecordCell 预制体（ResManager 内部已 Instantiate），列表非空时复用已有子物体，并把档位号、点击回调与选中标记只绑一次。
description.en: Node lookup and the cell factory: Locates RecordsList / BottomBar / ConfirmGroup by hard-coded names, then EnsureCells loads RecordCell from Resources (ResManager already instantiates it), reuses an existing child when the list is not empty, and binds slot number, click callback and selection marker exactly once.

description.zh: 按硬约定节点名找 RecordsList、底部按钮与确认浮层。
description.en: Finds RecordsList, bottom bar and confirm nodes.

description.zh: 绑定删除/返回按钮与确认浮层的三个按钮。
description.en: Binds delete/return and the confirm buttons.

description.zh: EnsureCells：只例化 3 个格子并长期复用。
description.en: EnsureCells: instantiates three cells once.

description.zh: 刷新与选中：整列表只取一次存档信息（不是每格取一次），分发到 3 个格子，刷选中高亮，并在选中档位为空时置灰删除按钮。OnEnter 只走这一块。另含点击档位、删除与返回的处理。
description.en: Refresh and selection: reads the save-slot info once for the whole list (not once per cell), pushes it into each RecordCell, highlights the selected slot, and greys the delete button when the selected slot is empty. OnEnter lands here and nothing else. Also handles cell click, delete and return.

description.zh: 统一取一次档位信息并分发给 3 个格子。
description.en: Pulls slot info once and paints all three cells.

description.zh: 点击档位、删除与返回的处理。
description.en: Cell click, delete and return handlers.

label.zh: 把档位数据分发给格子
label.en: Push slot data into a cell

label.zh: 删除/返回先弹二次确认

description.zh: 存档列表里的一个档位格子（RecordCell.prefab 的脚本）。Bind 与 SetData 刻意分开：SLPanel 只例化 3 个格子并长期复用，所以绑定必须只执行一次，而数据每次刷新都要重画。本类不碰文件系统——数据由 SLPanel 统一取一次再分发。
description.en: One save-slot cell (the RecordCell.prefab script). Bind and SetData are deliberately separate: SLPanel instantiates three cells once and reuses them forever, so binding must happen exactly once while data is repainted on every refresh. The cell never touches the file system — SLPanel fetches the data once and distributes it.

description.zh: 只执行一次的绑定：档位号、点击回调与选中标记。
description.en: One-time bind of slot number and click callback.

description.zh: 把当前档位状态画到界面，每次刷新都可调。
description.en: Paints the slot state; safe to call every refresh.

description.zh: 切换选中高亮标记。
description.en: Toggles the selected highlight marker.

description.zh: 把 UTC ticks 格式化成当地时间 yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm。
description.en: Formats UTC ticks as local yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm.

description.zh: 本格子代表的档位号。
description.en: The slot number this cell represents.

description.zh: 档位格子控件全文。
description.en: Whole RecordCell widget source.

description.zh: 设置界面：SettingPanel 是纯容器（切页、把玩家意图转给 SettingsManager、刷新「应用」按钮、退出时处理未应用的改动），具体的设置值全部由 SettingsPageBase 的五个子类负责——四个一级页加一个改键二级页。
description.en: Settings UI: SettingPanel is a pure container (tab switching, routing player intent to SettingsManager, apply-button refresh, handling unapplied edits). Values live in the five SettingsPageBase subclasses — four first-level pages plus the keybind-bindings sub page.

description.zh: SettingsPageBase（308 行）拆为三块：二级界面栈、用到才绑的生命周期、以及把 settingId 映射到 SettingsData 字段的一整套 Bind* 工具。
description.en: SettingsPageBase (308 lines) split into three: the second-level page stack, the use-on-demand binding lifecycle, and the Bind* helpers that map setting ids onto SettingsData fields.

description.zh: id 到字段的绑定工具箱：BindSlider/BindSelector/BindToggle/BindButton 各自把一个 settingId 接到 SettingsData 的读写委托上，玩家改动时通知 SettingsManager，并返回行引用供页面稍后置灰。FindRow 与 ValidateRows 负责揪出「prefab 里摆了行却没绑定」的情况。
description.en: The id-to-field binding toolkit: BindSlider/BindSelector/BindToggle/BindButton each map one settingId onto a getter and setter of SettingsData, notify SettingsManager when the player changes something, and return the row so a page can grey it out later. FindRow and ValidateRows catch rows that were placed in the prefab but never bound.

description.zh: 把拉条行接到 SettingsData 的某个字段。
description.en: Binds a slider row to a SettingsData field.

description.zh: 把选择器行接到字段（按下标读写）。
description.en: Binds a selector row (index-based).

description.zh: 把开关行接到布尔字段。
description.en: Binds a toggle row.

description.zh: 把按钮行接到一个动作。
description.en: Binds a button row to an action.

description.zh: 注册刷新动作（按注册顺序执行）。
description.en: Registers a refresh action (order matters).

description.zh: 绑定工具、FindRow 与「摆了行但没绑」校验。
description.en: Bind helpers, FindRow and row validation.

description.zh: 用到才绑的生命周期：面板调 EnsureBound，后者只跑一次 OnBind，并在物体未激活时明确报错。RefreshAll 把 Pending 快照灌回每个已注册的刷新动作，刻意走 SetValueWithoutNotify 以免「刷新→回调→写数据→再刷新」的自激循环。
description.en: Bind-on-first-use lifecycle: the panel calls EnsureBound, which runs OnBind exactly once and logs an error when the GameObject is still inactive. RefreshAll replays the Pending snapshot into every registered refresher, deliberately via SetValueWithoutNotify so refresh cannot feed back into itself.

description.zh: 幂等绑定；页未激活时明确报错而不是静默失效。
description.en: Idempotent bind; errors if the page is inactive.

description.zh: 子类钩子：在这里声明「哪一行改哪个字段」。
description.en: Subclass hook declaring id-to-field bindings.

description.zh: 把 Pending 的值灌回本页所有控件（不再触发回调）。
description.en: Replays Pending values into every widget.

description.zh: 用到才绑的生命周期段。
description.en: Bind-on-first-use lifecycle.

description.zh: 二级界面支持：一级页按节点名找自己的二级页，二级页只抛 OnBackRequested 而不知道自己在谁下面，CancelPendingEdit 逐层下问 OnCancelPendingEdit，让二级页丢掉采了一半的输入。
description.en: Second-level page support: a page finds its sub page by node name, the sub page raises OnBackRequested instead of knowing who owns it, and CancelPendingEdit walks down to OnCancelPendingEdit so a sub page can drop its half-collected input.

description.zh: 按节点名在同级里找二级页面组件。
description.en: Finds a sub page component by node name.

description.zh: 打开二级页面并触发父页回调。
description.en: Shows a sub page and notifies the parent.

description.zh: 收起二级页面（保留未应用改动）。
description.en: Hides the sub page, keeping edits.

description.zh: 关闭二级页面并返回一级。
description.en: Closes the sub page and returns.

description.zh: 当前是否有二级页面打开。
description.en: Whether a sub page is currently open.

description.zh: 二级界面段：查找/显隐二级页与取消待定编辑。
description.en: Second-level page stack and pending-edit cancel.

description.zh: 五个 SettingsPageBase 子类，设置值的真正归属：声音、画面、游戏性、按键，以及按键绑定的二级页。每页只声明「哪一行改哪个字段」，切页与生命周期由面板和基类负责。
description.en: The five SettingsPageBase subclasses that actually own the setting values: audio, graphics, gameplay, keybind, plus the keybind-bindings second-level page. Each page declares only which row maps to which SettingsData field; the panel and the base class do the rest.

description.zh: 声音页：全局/音乐/音效/UI 四路音量，0~100 步进 1。音量是「改完点应用才生效」的刻意例外——拖动时立即改变实际输出（听不到声音的拉条没法调），但存档值仍只写进暂存区，点应用才落盘。
description.en: Audio page: master/music/sfx/ui volume, all 0-100 step 1. Volume is the one deliberate exception to apply-on-commit — dragging changes the live AudioSource output immediately (a slider you cannot hear is unusable) while the saved value still only lands in the pending buffer until Apply.

description.zh: 声明全局/音乐/音效/UI 四路音量拉条。
description.en: Declares the four volume sliders.

description.zh: 四路音量拉条 0~100 步进 1，拖动时立即试听。
description.en: Four volume sliders, 0-100 step 1, with live preview.

description.zh: 游戏性页：目前只有语言切换一项，档位下标即 LanguageType 枚举值，直接存 SettingsData.language。档位文案来自 LocalizationManager.GetAllLanguages（只返回已启用语言），启用新语言不用改这里——但 prefab 是摆好的，需要重新生成。
description.en: Gameplay page: today it only holds the language selector, whose index doubles as the LanguageType enum value stored in SettingsData.language. Option texts come from LocalizationManager.GetAllLanguages so enabling a new language needs no change here — but the prefab is hand-built and must be regenerated.

description.zh: 绑定语言选择器。
description.en: Binds the language selector.

description.zh: 语言行与它的档位文案生成（只列已启用语言）。
description.en: Language row and its display-name options.

description.zh: 画面页：分辨率/视窗模式/帧率上限/垂直同步/画质。分辨率是唯一「选项列表运行时才定」的一项（超出显示器能力的档位被 ResolutionHelper 裁掉），所以选择器下标只是缓存表的下标；存档分辨率在当前显示器不存在时吸附到最近一档并写进暂存区。
description.en: Graphics page: resolution, window mode, frame-rate cap, vsync and quality. Resolution is the only list built at runtime (options beyond the monitor are filtered out by ResolutionHelper), so the selector index is just an offset into a cached table; a saved resolution that does not exist on the current monitor is snapped to the closest entry and written into the pending buffer.

description.zh: 绑定分辨率/视窗模式/帧率上限/垂直同步/画质五步。
description.en: Binds resolution, window mode, fps, vsync, quality.

description.zh: OnBind 与分辨率档位绑定（选项列表运行时才定）。
description.en: OnBind plus the resolution option binding.

description.zh: 存档分辨率在当前显示器不存在时吸附到最近一档。
description.en: Snaps a saved resolution missing on this monitor.

description.zh: 视窗模式/帧率/垂直同步/画质四项绑定。
description.en: Window mode, frame rate, vsync and quality rows.

description.zh: 按键一级页：水平/垂直反转、灵敏度、攻击触发方式——都只有鼠标才有意义，手柄方案下整行置灰但保留可见（玩家得先看见它存在）。「更改按键绑定」按钮把控制权交给二级页，并收回子页的返回回调。
description.en: Keybind first-level page: horizontal/vertical invert, sensitivity and attack trigger mode — all mouse-only, so they are greyed out (kept visible on purpose) while the gamepad scheme is active. Its 更改按键绑定 button hands over to the second-level bindings page and takes the back callback.

description.zh: 绑定鼠标专用项并接上进入改键二级页的按钮。
description.en: Binds mouse-only rows and opens the rebind page.

description.zh: 改键二级页在本页同级的节点名常量。
description.en: Node name of the second-level bindings page.

description.zh: 鼠标专用项与二级页转交（含手柄方案置灰）。
description.en: Mouse-only rows and the sub page hand-off.

description.zh: KeybindBindingsPage（617 行）拆为四块：页签与手柄型号、两套按键行、改键采集流程、单行与整方案恢复默认。键鼠的一条 1DAxis 复合绑定被拆成【左移】【右移】两行，每个方向能单独改。
description.en: KeybindBindingsPage (617 lines) split into four: header tabs, the two key-row sets, the rebind capture flow, and per-row/per-scheme reset. A composite 1DAxis binding is split into separate left/right rows so each direction can be rebound alone.

description.zh: 改键页顶部：返回按钮、键鼠/手柄页签、PS/Xbox 型号切换。切方案或切型号把 inputDevice / gamepadModel 写进暂存区，刷新两套按键行与页签图标，再通知 SettingsManager 点亮「应用」按钮。
description.en: Header of the rebind page: back button, keyboard/gamepad tabs and the PS/Xbox model switch. Switching scheme or model writes inputDevice / gamepadModel into the pending buffer, refreshes both row sets and the tab icons, then notifies SettingsManager so the Apply button lights up.

description.zh: 注册按键行与顶部刷新（刷新动作必须第一个注册）。
description.en: Registers rows and the header refresh first.

description.zh: 本二级页的节点名常量。
description.en: Node name of this second-level page.

description.zh: OnBind、页签、手柄型号切换与返回按钮。
description.en: OnBind, header tabs, gamepad model, back.

description.zh: 改键采集流程：先防重入（已有协程或 InputManager.IsRebinding 就拒绝），再逐步走 InputManager.GetRebindSteps 给出的提示，结果经 OnStepFinished 回传。等待按键期间整页锁住防误触；同步写 InputActionAsset 是刻意的——不写进去玩家看不到自己刚按的键。
description.en: Rebind capture flow: guards against re-entry (an in-flight routine or InputManager.IsRebinding), walks the steps given by InputManager.GetRebindSteps, and passes a rebound result back through OnStepFinished. While waiting for a key the whole page is locked; the immediate write to the InputActionAsset is deliberate so the player sees the key they just pressed.

description.zh: 防重入检查后开始一次按键采集。
description.en: Guards re-entry, then starts one capture step.

description.zh: RebindRoutine：逐步采集一条绑定的各段。
description.en: RebindRoutine: walks the steps for one row.

description.zh: 采集期间整页锁住，结束后清理监听与状态。
description.en: Locks the page while capturing and cleans up.

description.zh: 恢复默认的两条路径：单行（键盘/手柄/鼠标格，按段名处理）与整方案（清掉当前设备的全部覆盖，再把结果序列化回 Pending.inputOverridesJson）。先改实时资产，界面才能立刻反映出来。
description.en: Restore-defaults paths: per row (keyboard, gamepad or mouse slot, honouring the part name) and whole scheme (clear every override of the active device, then serialise the resulting overrides back into Pending.inputOverridesJson). Clearing happens on the live asset first so the UI reflects it immediately.

description.zh: 单行恢复默认：调 InputManager.ResetBinding。
description.en: Resets one row via InputManager.ResetBinding.

description.zh: 整方案恢复默认，并把当前覆盖同步回暂存区。
description.en: Resets a whole scheme and syncs overrides.

description.zh: 两套按键行：键鼠行是双格（键盘格 + 鼠标格，一个操作可同时绑键与鼠标），手柄行是单格。每格交给 KeyIconText——有图标显示图标、没有则回退文字，避免切语言时键名长度撑破固定列宽。
description.en: The two key-row sets: keyboard rows carry two slots (keyboard + mouse) so one action can be bound to both, gamepad rows carry one. Each row shows an icon via KeyIconText when a KeyIconMap entry exists and falls back to text, which keeps widths stable across languages. Reset writes back the action name, binding kind and part name per row.

description.zh: 构建按键行，并把 (文字, 图标, 颜色) 刷进行。
description.en: Builds key rows and refreshes their (text, icon).

description.zh: Button/marker/KeyIconText 的查找工具。
description.en: Button/marker/KeyIconText find helpers.

description.zh: SettingPanel（421 行）按职责拆开：生命周期与切页、硬约定节点查找、底部按钮条与「有未应用改动先问一句」的可选确认浮层。
description.en: SettingPanel (421 lines) split by responsibility: lifecycle/tab switching, hard-coded node lookup, and the bottom button bar plus the optional unsaved-changes confirmation overlay.

description.zh: 底部按钮条：应用（CommitEdit + 刷新各页）、恢复默认（按当前分类 ResetPendingSection）、返回。有未应用改动时返回会弹确认浮层；prefab 里没摆 ConfirmGroup 则退化成「直接丢弃 + 一条警告」，不会报错卡住。
description.en: Bottom button bar: Apply (CommitEdit + refresh every page), Reset (ResetPendingSection of the current category) and Return. Return pops a confirmation overlay when there are unapplied edits; if the prefab has no ConfirmGroup it degrades to discard-plus-warning instead of erroring.

description.zh: 应用/恢复默认/返回三个按钮与应用按钮亮灭刷新。
description.en: Apply/Reset/Return handlers and apply-button refresh.

description.zh: 返回确认浮层：显隐与确认/丢弃/取消三个回调。
description.en: Confirm overlay: show/hide and the three handlers.

description.zh: SettingPanel 的生命周期与切页：OnEnter 开启编辑会话，OnExit 处理未应用的改动，ShowCategory 必须先 SetActive(true) 再 EnsureBound()——顺序反了会在未激活状态下绑定，取值域没设、回调没接上却一声不响。
description.en: SettingPanel lifecycle and tab switching: OnEnter opens an edit session, OnExit deals with unapplied edits, and ShowCategory always activates the page before calling EnsureBound (reversing that order binds silently-nothing because Awake has not run yet).

description.zh: 面板打开：开启一次编辑会话。
description.en: Panel enter: begins an edit session.

description.zh: 面板关闭：结束编辑会话。
description.en: Panel exit: disposes the edit session.

description.zh: 生命周期段：Awake/OnEnable/OnDisable/OnEnter/OnExit 与取消未应用编辑。
description.en: Lifecycle: Awake/OnEnable/OnDisable/OnEnter/OnExit.

description.zh: ShowCategory：切页时先 SetActive 再 EnsureBound（顺序反了会静默失效）。
description.en: ShowCategory: activates then binds the target page.

reading.zh: 第一组是运行时代码：启动骨架 → 框架服务 → MVP 视图（调用方向从左到右）；第二组是数据与工具（配置表管线、编辑器工具）；第三组是资产与工程基建；第四组是团队协作契约与文档。箭头代表调用/引用。
reading.en: Left to right: runtime code (bootstrap → framework services → MVP views), data & tooling (config pipeline, editor tools), assets & project infra, then team process docs. Arrows are call/reference direction.

reading.zh: 从左到右四簇：先美术图形素材，再字体与文本渲染，然后 UI 预制体/本地化/输入，最后音频与杂项。箭头表示资产之间的引用（如瓦片引用贴图、设置行引用输入动作）。
reading.en: Four clusters left to right: art, fonts/text, UI+localization+input, then audio and misc. Arrows are asset references (tile to texture, setting row to input action).

reading.zh: 从左上到右下：先一份自制 Spine 角色，再 2D 贴图（草地瓦片）与输入图标集（按平台再分三层）。
reading.en: Left to right: the in-house Spine character first, then 2D textures (grass tiles) and the input icon set, which splits further by platform.

reading.zh: 左侧三框是三个平台的原始 PNG 图标集（键鼠 241 / PS 104 / Xbox 91），右侧图集把它们打图打包供运行时按名取图。
reading.en: The three left boxes are the per-platform PNG sets (keyboard-mouse 241 / PS 104 / Xbox 91); the right box packs them into one atlas for name lookup.

reading.zh: 左为唯一真实音效（牛叫），右为 41 首测试 BGM；两者均为 Resources 下直接加载。
reading.en: Left: the single real SFX (cow moo). Right: 41 test BGM tracks. Both load straight from Resources.

reading.zh: 四种语言各一格，每格同时保留原始 TTF/TTC 与生成出的 TMP SDF 资产；箭头指向 TMP 全局设置（本地化字体受其管辖）。
reading.en: One box per language, each holding the raw TTF/TTC plus the generated TMP SDF asset; the arrow goes to TMP Settings, which governs these fonts.

reading.zh: 从左到右：根据配置（含语言→字体映射）聚合右侧 4 张分面板子配置；左框另有箭头指向中文字体。
reading.en: Left to right: the root config (with the language-to-font map) aggregates the four per-panel sub configs; the root also points at the Chinese fonts.

reading.zh: 两格互相独立：左侧测试 Cube 是沙箱遗留，右侧 DOTween 设置被 DOTween 运行时读取。
reading.en: Two independent boxes: the test cube on the left is sandbox leftover; the DOTween settings on the right are read by the DOTween runtime.

reading.zh: 先看全局配置（TMP Settings 与断行表），再看它管辖的字体与精灵资产，最后是渲染用的着色器。
reading.en: Start with the global config (TMP Settings + line-breaking tables), then the fonts and sprites it governs, then the render shaders.

reading.zh: 从左到右是启动链路：Entry 按次序拉起各管理器 → MonoManager 提供帧驱动与协程 → ScenesLoadManager 是全工程唯一调 SceneManager 的地方 → LoadingController 持控读条与激活 → 场景资产由构建清单决定哪些能被加载。
reading.en: Left to right is the boot chain: Entry brings the managers up in order → MonoManager supplies the tick and coroutines → ScenesLoadManager is the only caller of SceneManager → LoadingController owns the bar and activation → the build list decides which scenes can be loaded.

reading.zh: 同一份 LoadingController.cs 按职责切成五块：先定位节点并写进度条，再由 load-orchestration 跑加载时序；轮播图决定 assetsReady 何时为 1，failure-state 是卡死前的兜底，metrics 供自动化验收读取。
reading.en: One LoadingController.cs split by responsibility: nodes are located and the bar updated first, load-orchestration runs the timing; the carousel decides when assetsReady reaches 1, failure-state is the pre-freeze fallback and metrics feeds automated acceptance.

reading.zh: 左 → 右是调用方向：manager 是单例门面，controller 才是真正挂在 GameObject 上、每帧扇出 updateEvent 的 MonoBehaviour。
reading.en: Left to right is the call direction: manager is the singleton facade, controller is the MonoBehaviour that actually lives on a GameObject and fans out updateEvent each frame.

reading.zh: 这一层只有一块：ScenesLoadManager 把三种加载方式（同步 / 协程异步 / 持控异步）收在同一个类里，SceneManager 的调用点不散到别处。
reading.en: A single box on this layer: ScenesLoadManager keeps all three load modes (sync, coroutine async, hands-off async) in one class so SceneManager calls never scatter.

reading.zh: 按启动链路排：TestScene（构建清单第 0 项，挂 Entry 起手）→ LoadingScene（读条）→ WorldScene（游戏世界）；EnterScene 未被 EditorBuildSettings 登记，排在最后。
reading.en: Ordered by the boot chain: TestScene (build entry 0, hosts Entry) → LoadingScene (progress) → WorldScene (the game world); EnterScene is not registered in EditorBuildSettings and sits last.

reading.zh: 三种单例形态并列，按“要不要 MonoBehaviour”递增：base 供普通 C# 类（懒 new）、mono 需手动挂到场景、auto-mono 首次取值时自动建对象并跨场景保留。
reading.en: Three singleton flavours side by side, increasing in MonoBehaviour-ness: base for plain C# classes (lazy new), mono requires manual placement, auto-mono creates its own object and survives scenes.

reading.zh: 按链路读：源表/文案表 → 导出器（类型白名单逐格把关）→ 生成 Json 与数据类 → 运行时 ConfigLoader/Recorder 读它们并把可写数据写回 .record。注意 config-pipeline 不得指向 editor-tools（policy 强制）。
reading.en: Follow the chain: source tables, exporter (type whitelist gates every cell), generated JSON and classes, then runtime loading and .record saves. Note config-pipeline must never depend on editor-tools.

reading.zh: 从菜单入口进入：先按 7 行表头约定读表（行号常量硬编码），再分两路产出——数据类生成器，以及 Json 写出（键值拼装 → 美化）；最后经 FileUtil 写盘，它不会替你建目录。
reading.en: Start at the menu entry: read tables per the 7-row header contract (row indices hard-coded), then emit along two paths - the class generator and the JSON writer (pair assembly, then pretty-printing) - and finally save through FileUtil, which never creates folders for you.

reading.zh: 两份 Json 结构都是 {"datas":[...]}：TestTable 验证多类型列，LoadingTable 验证 bool 裸小写与浮点列。它们是导出产物，不要手改。
reading.en: Both files share the {"datas":[...]} shape: TestTable exercises mixed column types, LoadingTable exercises a bare-lowercase bool and float columns. They are generated - do not hand-edit.

reading.zh: 上半组是 Config 模式的只读常量类，下半组是 Data 模式的可写存档类；两者字段都由表头第 3/4/6 行决定，导出时整份覆盖。
reading.en: The top group holds read-only Config-mode classes, the bottom one the writable Data-mode class. Both are driven by header rows 3, 4 and 6 and are overwritten wholesale on every export.

reading.zh: 两张 CSV 是本地化编辑器导出/导入的交换格式，内容为派生产物：改文案要回到配置资产再导出，不要直接改 CSV。
reading.en: These two CSVs are the interchange format used by the localization editor's export/import. They are derived artifacts: edit the config asset and re-export instead of editing the CSV.

reading.zh: 左侧是常量表读取（ConfigLoader，当前因路径前缀不匹配而读不到，见描述）；右侧是存档链路：构造时全量读入缓存 → 增删改查 → 写盘前统一美化。
reading.en: On the left, constant-table loading (ConfigLoader, currently broken by a path prefix mismatch - see its description). On the right, the save chain: load everything into a cache, run CRUD, then pretty-print before writing.

reading.zh: 两张表都是管线样本：测试表验证多类型列，读条轮播表验证 bool 列与资源路径列；README 只是占位，约定其实写在 ConfigManager 里。
reading.en: Both workbooks are pipeline samples: TestTable covers multiple column types, LoadingTable covers a bool column and asset paths. The README is only a placeholder; the real conventions live in ConfigManager.

reading.zh: 四个分组对应日常动作：内容编辑（本地化文案、剧情对话）→ 工作流与场景（Git 拉取、Scene 视图 UI 分离）→ 美术与图标管线（图集、按键图标）→ 预制体与插件设置。点开任一项继续下钻到具体窗口与代码行段。
reading.en: Four groups map to daily actions: content editing (localization text, dialogue), workflow and scene (Git pull, scene-view UI separation), art and icon pipeline (atlas, key icons), prefab and plugin settings. Drill into any of them for windows and code ranges.

reading.zh: 先看导入策略（每张贴图落进工程时的口径），再看图集构建与体检（只打包被映射表引用的图，并报告页数与估算显存）。
reading.en: First the import policy (how each icon enters the project), then the atlas build and inspect step, which packs only icons referenced by the map and reports pages and estimated memory.

reading.zh: 从左到右：左栏选对话资产与人物 → 右栏编辑台词、选项与事件 → 全部落在一个 DialogData 资产上。
reading.en: Left to right: pick a dialogue asset and its characters, edit entries, options and events, all persisted into one DialogData asset.

reading.zh: 从左到右：git 命令与仓库查询 → 改动分级与更新预览 → 窗口的检查/拉取/放弃本地更改流程 → 窗口展示层。箭头从右往左就是窗口在调用底层能力。
reading.en: Left to right: git commands and repo queries, change classification and preview, the window's check/pull/discard flows, then presentation. Arrows pointing left are the window calling into lower layers.

reading.zh: 先由命名规则把 Art/icon 的文件名解析成控制键，窗口据此自动匹配映射表，再把图标位补到预制体按键行上。
reading.en: The naming rules first turn Art/icon file names into control keys, the window auto-matches them into the map, and the patcher adds icon slots to prefab key rows.

reading.zh: 按数据流读：扫描收集面板文字 → 勾选导入子配置 → 回写 LocalizedText 组件；合并器再把子配置并成运行期整表。右侧组是条目编辑器（窗口/字段/CSV）与字体映射。
reading.en: Read left to right: scan panel text, import into sub-configs, write LocalizedText back; the merger then folds sub-configs into the runtime table. The right groups cover the entry editor (window, fields, CSV) and the font map.

reading.zh: 开关与对象级隐藏是主干，预览面板把 Canvas 画到视图左侧，隐藏账本负责跨 Unity 重启的自愈。Play 期间只跑前两块。
reading.en: The toggle plus object-level hiding are the trunk, the preview panel draws canvases into the left of the view, and the ledger heals orphan hidden objects across editor restarts. During play only the first two run.

reading.zh: 按“先用后玩”读：左组是路径/日志/事件/资源/对象池等全局底座，第二组是 UI 与输入，第三组是本地化与设置，最后一组是音频、存档、对话与自测脚本；箭头是子模块之间的调用/引用关系。
reading.en: Read left to right: global foundations (paths, logging, events, resources, pool), then UI & input, then localization & settings, and finally audio, save, dialogue and dev-test probes. Arrows are call/reference links between the submodules.

reading.zh: 从左到右：先看通道与音量模型（Master/Music/Sound/UI），再看 BGM 与音效两条播放链路；两者都经 ResManager 取片段、经 GlobalPath 定位目录。
reading.en: Left to right: the channel/volume model first, then the BGM and SFX playback paths; both load clips through ResManager and locate folders through GlobalPath.

reading.zh: 五组 OnGUI/启动探针，分别验证音频、配置与存档、输入、对象池、UI；都挂在 TestScene 的 GameManager 上但当前 enabled=false，需手工开启才能跑。
reading.en: Five OnGUI/startup probes for audio, config & save, input, pool and UI. They sit on TestScene's GameManager but are all disabled, so they must be enabled to run.

reading.zh: 从左到右：对话配置资产 → 播放流程（开始/推进/跳转）→ 打字机与选项等内部实现。注意 TestScene 内没有 DialogueManager 实例，当前不可用。
reading.en: Left to right: the dialogue asset, the playback flow (start/advance/jump) and the typewriter/options internals. Note there is no DialogueManager instance in TestScene today.

reading.zh: 从左到右：事件名常量与参数类型 → EventManager 总线 → TriggerEvent 拓展方法（发送便捷入口）；最右侧是 [Obsolete(...,true)] 的旧 EventCenter，引用即编译错误。
reading.en: Left to right: event-name constants and args types, the EventManager bus, and the TriggerEvent extension as a one-line sender; the last box is the Obsolete(...,true) EventCenter that fails compilation if referenced.

reading.zh: 按使用顺序读：Init 加载 InputActions → 覆盖项 JSON 存取 → 绑定的显示与重置 → 改键（步骤拆分 → 监听流程 → 冲突解绑）→ 每帧按键轮询抛出事件。
reading.en: Read in usage order: Init loads the InputActions, overrides are persisted as JSON, bindings are displayed/reset, rebinding runs (step split, listening, conflict clearing) and finally per-frame polling raises key events.

reading.zh: 从左到右：映射表资产结构 → 缓存加载（Active/Load/ResetCache）→ 查询取图 → 维护补录，右侧三个都指回资产定义。
reading.en: Left to right: the asset structure, the cached loading layer, icon lookup, and maintenance/backfill; the three right-hand boxes all point back to the asset definition.

reading.zh: 从左到右：语言枚举与条目 → 配置资产 → 管理器与取词 → LocalizedText 组件落地 → 字体映射与应用 → 设置选项 Key 表。语言切换事件从管理器广播给文本与字体组件。
reading.en: Left to right: language enum and entries, the config asset, manager and lookup, the LocalizedText component, font mapping/application and the setting option key table. The language-changed event flows from the manager to text and font components.

reading.zh: 调用方从右往左看：业务代码用 levels 的快捷方法或 Write 起一条链式日志，链式构建器经频道/颜色着色后交给 core 输出；config/channels/colors 是这三条链路依赖的配置表。
reading.en: Read right to left for callers: business code uses the level shortcuts or Write to start a fluent line, the builder colors it via channel/color tables and core emits it. Config, channels and colors are the tables those paths depend on.

reading.zh: 两个常量文件：GlobalPath 管磁盘/资源路径，PanelType 管面板类型的枚举；全工程其它模块都指向它们取证。
reading.en: Two constant files: GlobalPath holds disk/resource paths, PanelType the panel-type enum. Most other framework modules point here for evidence.

reading.zh: 先看单个池的存储结构，再看管理器：按名字分池、GetObj 取用（缺则经 ResManager 实例化）、PushObj 回收、Clear 清空。
reading.en: Start with the per-pool storage type, then the manager: named pools, GetObj (instantiating via ResManager when empty), PushObj return and Clear.

reading.zh: 单模块：ResManager 是 Resources.Load/LoadAsync 的薄封装；注意 Load<GameObject> 已内部 Instantiate，调用方不要再实例化一次。
reading.en: Single module: ResManager wraps Resources.Load/LoadAsync. Note Load<GameObject> already instantiates, so callers must not instantiate again.

reading.zh: 从左到右：先看存档数据结构，再看服务读取（恒返 3 槽）与写入（保存/新建/删除），最后是跨场景传递选中槽与负载的 GameSession。
reading.en: Left to right: the save data types, the service read side (always 3 slots), the write side (save/create/delete), and finally GameSession carrying the selected slot and payload across scenes.

reading.zh: 所有行都继承基类：先看基类与按键图标文本组件，再看按钮/开关/滑条等简单行，然后是选择器行，最后是结构最复杂的改键行（核心/显示/监听三段）。
reading.en: Every row inherits the base: start with the base class and KeyIconText, then the simple rows (button/toggle/slider), then the selector row, and finally the keybind row split into core, display and listening.

reading.zh: 左侧是数据契约（id 常量、选项枚举、数据模型、分辨率工具），右侧是管理器四段：状态与初始化 → 读写盘 → 编辑会话 → 应用到运行时（音频/本地化/输入）。
reading.en: Left side is the data contract (ids, option enums, data model, resolution helper); right side is the manager in four steps: state/init, disk IO, edit session, and apply-to-runtime (audio, localization, input).

reading.zh: 从左到右：UIManager 管面板栈与实例化 → BasePanel 管生命周期与显隐 → 基类的光标/暂停辅助；最右侧是 [Obsolete] 的 TangLaoShi 旧实现，仅作历史留档。
reading.en: Left to right: UIManager owns the panel stack, BasePanel the lifecycle and show/hide, then the base class cursor/pause helpers; the last box is the obsolete TangLaoShi implementation kept for history.

reading.zh: 先看动画类型枚举与 Inspector 配置，再看公开播放接口（PlayEnter/PlayExit）及其内部实现（静止状态录制、依次入场），最后是可选的依次入场标记组件。
reading.en: Start with the animation-type enum and inspector config, then the public playback API and its internals (rest-state capture, stagger), and finally the optional stagger marker component.

reading.zh: MVP 三件套的现状：view 是已实现的面板；model 目前只有一个手写 DTO（生成的 ConfigData/ModelData 归属配置表管线，不在本层）；presenter 是空目录占位。
reading.en: The MVP trio as it stands: view holds the implemented panels; model has a single hand-written DTO (generated ConfigData/ModelData belongs to the config pipeline, not here); presenter is an empty placeholder.

reading.zh: 本层目前只有一个手写模型。注意它在工程里还没有任何消费方。
reading.en: Only one hand-written model exists today. Note it has no consumer anywhere in the project yet.

reading.zh: 三个界面域并列：主菜单是入口，设置与存档都由主菜单按 PanelType 推入 UIManager 的栈。
reading.en: Three side-by-side UI domains: the main menu is the entry, and both settings and save/load are pushed onto the UIManager stack from it by PanelType.

reading.zh: 格子是被动控件，SLPanel 只建 3 个并往里推数据。左 → 右是数据方向：档位信息 → 格子。
reading.en: The cell is a passive widget; SLPanel builds three of them once and pushes data in. Left to right is the data direction: slot info → cell.

reading.zh: 左 → 右是运行流程：Awake 绑定并建 3 个格子（只做一次）→ OnEnter 只刷新 → 点击进入共用的二次确认 → 确认后执行新建/读取/删除。
reading.en: Left to right is the runtime flow: Awake binds nodes and builds the three cells once → OnEnter only refreshes → a click enters the shared confirm overlay → confirming runs create/load/delete.

reading.zh: 左 → 右是依赖方向：page-base 定义「行→字段」的契约，panel 只管切页与转达意图，pages 才是设置值的归属。
reading.en: Left to right is the dependency direction: page-base defines the row-to-field contract, panel only switches tabs and routes intent, pages own the actual setting values.

reading.zh: 同一份 SettingsPageBase.cs 切成三块：二级界面栈、用到才绑的生命周期、以及各页在 OnBind 里调用的 Bind* 工具。
reading.en: One SettingsPageBase.cs split three ways: the second-level page stack, the bind-on-first-use lifecycle, and the Bind* toolkit each page calls from OnBind.

reading.zh: 按设置面板的页签顺序（Gameplay → Keybind → Graphics → Audio，与 SettingCategory 枚举一致）排列；按键绑定二级页由按键页进入，排在最后。
reading.en: Ordered by the panel tab order (Gameplay → Keybind → Graphics → Audio, matching the SettingCategory enum); the keybind-bindings second-level page is reached from the keybind page and sits last.

reading.zh: 同一份 KeybindBindingsPage.cs 切成四块：页签决定当前方案，rows 负责显示，rebind 采集新键，reset 恢复单行或整方案的默认。
reading.en: One KeybindBindingsPage.cs split four ways: header tabs pick the scheme, rows display it, rebind captures a new key, reset restores defaults for one row or a whole scheme.

reading.zh: 同一份 SettingPanel.cs 切成三块：节点查找在 Awake 做，生命周期与切页驱动各页，底部按钮条负责提交或丢弃暂存改动。
reading.en: One SettingPanel.cs split three ways: node lookup happens in Awake, lifecycle/tab switching drives the pages, the bottom bar commits or discards the pending edit.

reading.zh: 四簇：先包依赖与工程设置（基线），再第三方插件（Spine / DOTween / DLL），然后 Python 生成脚本与其产出的说明文档，最后仓库与 Agent 协作事项。跨簇箭头表示插件/脚本对资产的引用。
reading.en: Four clusters: packages+settings baseline, third-party plugins, the Python docs pipeline and its output manuals, then repo/agent ops. Cross-cluster arrows show plugin and script references.

reading.zh: 左为系统使用类说明（日志/面板动画/Scene 分离/本地化），右为管线类说明（Excel 配置表工具/MVP 分层）；两者都被 python-docs 的脚本写入或校验。
reading.en: Left: system guides (logging, panel animation, scene-view UI, localization). Right: pipeline guides (Excel tool, MVP layers). Both are written or checked by the python-docs scripts.

reading.zh: 左运行时 DLL（UI 面板动画走这里），右编辑器 DLL（DOTween Utility Panel）；运行时另有箭头指向 Assets 侧的 DOTweenSettings。
reading.en: Left: the runtime DLL used by UI panel animations. Right: the editor DLL (Utility Panel). The runtime also points at the DOTweenSettings asset in the assets tree.

reading.zh: 左运行时、中编辑器扩展、右包元数据；运行时代码不得引用编辑器程序集，这是架构硬约束。
reading.en: Runtime on the left, editor extension in the middle, package metadata on the right. Runtime code must never reference the editor assembly.

reading.zh: 左栏是 76 个示例脚本（箭头指向 Spine 运行时），中间是 168 个示例骨架资源，右栏是示例场景与音频。全部只作参考，不属游戏内容。
reading.en: Left: 76 example scripts (arrow to the Spine runtime). Middle: 168 example skeletons. Right: example scenes and audio. All reference material, not game content.

reading.zh: 三簇各两格：先工程身份与输入/物理，再渲染与音频时序，最后服务开关与编辑器工具链；本层无内部箭头（各文件互不引用）。
reading.en: Three pairs: identity+input/physics, rendering+audio/time, then services+editor toolchain. No internal arrows — these files do not reference each other.

reading.zh: 从左到右：样式脚手架 → 三个生成/修订脚本（生成 Learn 下的手册）→ 自检脚本回查产物。
reading.en: Left to right: style scaffold, then the builder/patcher scripts that write the Learn manuals, then the self-check that reads the output back.

reading.zh: 从团队契约与模板开始，然后是企划/配置表规范，再看架构，最后是程序侧实测记录。
reading.en: Start with the contract and templates, then the design docs, then architecture, then the programmer-side measured records.

reading.zh: 从左到右：实测现状核查 → 目标蓝图/路径规范/MVP 契约 → 各功能落地方案。
reading.en: Left to right: measured as-is audit → target blueprint/rules/MVP contract → per-feature landing plans.

reading.zh: 先读契约（分层与 Presenter），再看数据怎么流，最后是按风险排序的落地路线。
reading.en: Contract first (layers and Presenter), then how data flows, then the risk-ordered landing roadmap.

reading.zh: 同一份文档的顺序：先路径基准与 GlobalPath，再命名规范、生成物隔离与类型权威。
reading.en: Same document in reading order: path bases and GlobalPath first, then naming, generated-artifact isolation and the Type authority.

reading.zh: 清单 → 通用填写规范 → 单表字段规格。本层所有类型都以 ConfigManager.Convert 为唯一权威。
reading.en: Inventory → general filling rules → per-table field specs. Everything here is mirrored from ConfigManager.Convert.

reading.zh: 先读流程弄清谁写什么，再读开工前必读与分支纪律，最后是类型权威与轻量通道。
reading.en: Read workflow first to know who writes what, then the pitfalls/branch rules, then the type authority and the lightweight path.

reading.zh: 先看索引掌握全貌，再看模板使用说明，最后是两份模板本体。
reading.en: Index first for the lay of the land, then the template guide, then the two template bodies.

reading.zh: 同一份文档的阅读顺序：目标与核心循环 → 玩法与数值 → 范围风险与用户原始输入附录。
reading.en: One document in reading order: pillars and core loop, then modules and numerics, then scope/risks and the verbatim user input.

reading.zh: 先看有什么能力（清单），再看配置表管线的真实行为，最后是改代码时必须遵守的约定。
reading.en: What exists (capability inventory), what the config pipeline really does, and the rules for touching code.

reading.zh: 按实际需要顺序：编码 → 生成物/.meta → 命名空间与编译门禁 → MCP 规则与交接自检。
reading.en: Rules in the order you need them: encodings, generated artifacts/.meta, namespaces and the compile gate, then MCP rules and the handoff checklist.

reading.zh: 实测管线按顺序读：链路 → 行与类型裁定 → 路径错位实证 → 导出回归与结论。
reading.en: The measured pipeline in order: chain, then row/type verdicts, then the path-mismatch proof, then the export regression and conclusions.

reading.zh: 同一份文档按章节顺序拆分：范围与程序集 → 各 GameBase 子系统 → 末尾的实测附录与给架构师的阻塞清单。
reading.en: One document split by chapter in original order: scope/assemblies, then each GameBase subsystem, ending with the measured appendix and the architect blocker list.
